AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world’s first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn’t tied to title or tenure; it’s defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you’ll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

About the Delivery Engineering team

The hyperexponential Delivery Engineering team is a unique blend of engineers, actuaries, mathematicians and data scientists. We don’t take on traditional “transformations” (we have brilliant partners for that) – we specialise in handling only the most difficult and interesting problems our customers face, where only a combination of technical depth, market expertise and hx knowledge will do.

The Delivery Engineering team are the experts' experts of the hx platform, knowing it top-to-bottom, inside-out – both breadth and depth. You’ll learn its limits and which can be pushed. You’ll uncover every trick in the book, the secret combinations, and the shortcuts. You’ll combine all of this with a growing knowledge of insurance technology to present 'the art of the possible' to our customers and help shape cutting-edge tech, while working alongside some of the brightest, most ambitious people in the tech and insurance industries.

What you’ll be doing

  • Own end-to-end model delivery on hx, from scoping and build through to testing, iteration, and customer delivery.

  • Build and maintain production-grade Python models, applying modern engineering and modelling practices.

  • Work directly with customer actuarial teams and internal stakeholders to solve complex, ambiguous modelling and coding problems.

  • Raise quality across the team through code review, testing, and contributions to best-practice model development guidance.

  • Support and mentor junior model developers through pairing, feedback, and day-to-day delivery support.

  • Continuously look for ways to improve our model development standards, tooling, and ways of working.

What you’ll need to have done

  • Shipped and maintained production-grade Python code in complex or data-heavy environments.

  • Applied predictive modelling or advanced analytics in real-world settings (insurance or reinsurance exposure is a bonus, not a requirement).

  • Taken ownership of ambiguous problems, creating structure and driving them through to high-quality outcomes.

  • Worked directly with non-technical stakeholders or customers, translating requirements into robust technical solutions.

  • Operated effectively in a high-trust, high-accountability environment, proactively driving your own development and learning.

You’re unlikely to thrive here if

  • You prefer following detailed instructions rather than experimenting and finding your own approach.

  • You are uncomfortable working directly with non-technical stakeholders to understand their challenges.

  • You avoid tackling ambiguous or open-ended problems where the solution isn’t obvious.

If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you’ll do your best work. We’re building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us.

Compensation

At hx, we’re committed to salary transparency. You’ll always have clarity on pay early in the process - our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations - and we’re working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally.

Because we’re building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don’t always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that’s competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make.

Benefits

  • £5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development.

  • 25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total).

  • Company pension scheme via Penfold.

  • Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life.

  • Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno.

  • Private healthcare insurance through AXA.

  • Income protection and Life Insurance.

  • Cycle to Work Scheme

Additional perks

  • Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.).

  • Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and game nights.

  • Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry.

  • Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together.

Interview process

  • Initial call with our Talent team - 30 minutes

  • Take-home Python challenge followed by Skills Interview - 1 hour

  • Manager Interview - 1 hour

  • Values Interview - 1 hour

  • Meet the CEO

Our commitment to Diversity

hxer's are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive.

Diversity is not just the right thing to do, it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure. If you’re energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team.

Next steps

If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply or share it with your connections! Our dedicated talent team reviews all applications, and we promise to provide feedback regardless of the outcome.

descriptionHtml:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About The Team

Anduril's Growth organization identifies, shapes, captures, and grows new opportunities for the company.

This role sits within the Connected Warfare Division. Connected Warfare builds the software and hardware substrate for global, multi-domain command and control (C2) — joint, time-sensitive, connected mesh ecosystems that link every robot, human, and sensor across every domain to close kill chains and enable mission autonomy. The division includes the Voyager team, which delivers ruggedised computing and communications platforms for the network edge.About the Job

  • This is a sales role. You are here to hunt and close new business for Connected Warfare across Europe and the Middle East.
  • Based in continental Europe, you'll report to the Head of Growth for Anduril's International Connected Warfare business. You carry initial responsibility for the region, with scope to expand as the business scales.
  • European defence environments come with sovereign requirements, legacy architectures, and security constraints. You will know these pain points cold and demonstrate how Anduril integrates with — and supercharges — the systems customers already operate.
  • The work is matrixed: you'll pull on programs, engineering, capture, software, finance, partners, and customers to win. The deliverable is unambiguous: pipeline, partners, and signed contracts. This is an individual-contributor role — no direct reports. Your impact is measured in the business you build and the contracts you close

What You’ll Do

  • Drive go-to-market. Stand up and execute the Connected Warfare growth strategy across Europe and the Middle East. Identify, qualify, shape, and close complex opportunities with Allied nations, navigating international procurement cycles and sovereign requirements to secure long-term programs of record.

  • Deliver the number. Hit financial performance targets and build the multi-year plan to back them up. Provide leadership with long-term growth and product strategy for Connected Warfare in region.
  • Inform product. Translate region-specific mission profiles, sovereign cloud requirements, and degraded-network realities back into the product roadmap.
  • Represent Anduril. Communicate technical and operational value to senior military officials, procurement officers, and partners — articulating how Lattice-enabled C2 closes kill chains in contested environments

Growth Activities

  • Use Salesforce as the system of record — accounts, pricing, points of contact, expected close dates, and all customer activity
  • Partner with Sales Engineering to refine customer solutions
  • Perform live and static demonstrations on-site or via VTC
  • Create and deliver client presentations and proposals tailored to specific customer needs
  • Identify regional contract vehicles (e.g. NATO frameworks, national procurement programmes) and lead proposal development

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years in defence, dual-use, or enterprise networking sales, with at least 5 years closing business with European government and military customers
  • A proven hunter: documented record of identifying, qualifying, and closing complex deals with European Ministries of Defence (MoDs), NATO bodies, or coalition partners — opened the door, shaped the requirement, closed the contract
  • Deep familiarity with European defence procurement cycles, budgeting, and sovereign security frameworks
  • Ability to quickly master highly technical concepts (mesh networking, edge compute, C2, cloud architecture) and credibly brief senior military and technical leaders
  • A builder with high agency: has stood up a regional pipeline, country, or business line from a standing start — not just managed an existing book. Owns outcomes, prioritizes ruthlessly, operates well in greenfield environments
  • Operates effectively in a matrixed organization — partners well with BL leadership, engineering, capture, and corporate functions. Low ego, high collaboration
  • Demonstrated experience building and managing a regional channel — resellers, system integrators, and prime partnerships
  • Strong command of capture management or an equivalent enterprise sales pursuit methodology
  • Strong cross-cultural communication and negotiation skills
  • Native or fluent English; a second European language (Dutch, German, French) or Arabic is a plus
  • Willingness to travel up to 50% across Europe and the Middle East
  • Right to work in the EU; eligible to obtain and maintain EU and/or NATO-level security clearances

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior operational or industry experience in C4ISR, JADC2, or tactical communications — including service in an allied military, intelligence, or government digital/IT function
  • Established network within European military headquarters, defence procurement agencies, and European defence primes
  • Experience supporting export-controlled programs (US ITAR / EAR, UK Export Control, EU dual-use) and navigating sovereign data residency / cloud hosting regulations

title: Director Go-to-Market and Revenue Strategy
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today.

We are Prosus, a global technology company powering some of the world's leading lifestyle ecommerce businesses. Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover.

Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI.

Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate.

Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale.

WHO YOU ARE

You are a commercial leader who has built the go-to-market of a platform from a blank page and knows what it takes to turn a product that people already use into a business that pays for itself. You have priced and packaged products for marketplaces, brands or merchants, and you have seen the difference between a model that looks good in a spreadsheet and one that a small business owner actually adopts.

You are comfortable in a B2B2C world: the customer is reached through someone else's channel, the data belongs to the ecosystem, and the money comes from several ends of a transaction at once. You influence without authority, because the teams that execute will rarely report to you. You are rigorous with numbers and plain with people, and you are at ease saying what the evidence shows even when the room expects something else.

You want to build something that reaches millions of small businesses, you are prepared to work for it.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Toqan for Partners is the AI assistant for the merchants across the companies of the Prosus ecosystem: restaurants, pharmacies, hotels, sellers, real estate agencies and car dealers, five million businesses in total. It launched to restaurants on iFood in Brazil in September 2026 and reached 65,000 restaurants in four weeks with no media spend.

The next twelve months decide how it will become a business: which applications partners pay for and at what price, how value is shared with everyone the partner transacts with, how the uplift is measured and published so the next company embeds, and how the product travels from iFood to the rest of the ecosystem and to India and Europe. You will lead that work, as the owner of the go-to-market and the revenue strategy of Toqan for Partners, alongside the product and technology leads who own what gets built.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Own the commercial model

Define pricing and packaging for the applications partners pay for, media management, supply, finance and operations, at a fraction of what they spend today and justified by the return they see. Design how Toqan takes part in the value it creates for the other end: take rate on agent-negotiated supply, credit origination, brand and industry media, and cross-sell of the ecosystem companies' own products. Set the rules that keep it honest, starting with the separation between paid placement and recommendation.

Drive the rollout across the ecosystem

With the Head of Operations, secure the commitment of each business in the ecosystem: sponsor, distribution, conditional yes and first market. Run the rollout inside each one, working through the teams that own the merchant relationship, and bring the product to its next verticals and markets.

Build the measurement

Own the scoreboard: active partners under a strict definition, uplift per business in retention and GMV, cost and value per active partner. Make the uplift the argument that brings the next company in and the evidence behind every pricing decision.

Structure the partnerships that carry the revenue

Lead the commercial agreements with distributors, industry, fintechs and the ecosystem companies' commercial platforms, from first conversation to signed terms, and the co-investment models that align their incentives with the partner's.

Build and lead the team

Hire and develop a small go-to-market and revenue team, growth on the merchant side, monetisation and analytics, and set its standard for rigour, ownership and candour.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • Ten or more years in go-to-market, revenue or commercial strategy, with at least one commercial function built from scratch and grown to scale.

  • Hands-on experience with pricing and packaging, ideally for marketplaces, retail media, payments or SaaS sold to small businesses.

  • Experience on more than one side of a marketplace: merchants or sellers, brands or suppliers, the platform itself.

  • A track record of adoption at scale with a long tail of small customers, not only of large enterprise deals.

  • Proven ability to move a result through teams that do not report to you, and to work inside another company's channel.

  • Fluency with data: you build the business case, run the analysis and read the uplift yourself, and use AI tooling as a normal part of how you work.

  • Candour, humility and patience: you say what the numbers say, you arrive to learn before you teach.

  • English required; Portuguese or Spanish strongly preferred.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Global impact: a product that reaches five million small businesses across Latin America, Europe and India.

  • Ownership: the commercial model of a new business, with the numbers to be judged on and the autonomy to build it.

  • Growth: exposure to the leadership of the group and of its companies, and a clear path into operating roles in the ecosystem.

  • Competitive compensation and the Prosus benefits package for the location of the role.

Why Prosus?

At Prosus, your colleagues include 60,000 AI agents… and your job is to figure out what that actually means. We're one of the largest operators of agentic AI on the planet, inside a $100B+ portfolio across 100+ companies and two billion people. The humans here own what AI can't do alone: judgment, creativity, and the call on what gets built next.

Own the impact. Work the ecosystem. Earn your growth. Build with backing.

Curious about our perks and benefits? Take a look at this page.

Our Diversity & Inclusion Commitment

We respect the dignity and human rights of individuals and communities wherever we operate in the world. Building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome and can thrive is critical for us. We provide access to education, which helps everyone understand the important role they play and the positive impact they can have.

Want to know more about life at Prosus? Explore our culture and values.

title: Electronics Engineering Manager
descriptionHtml:
About IonQ: 

IonQ, Inc. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance.

Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.  

The Role

We are looking for an Electronics Engineering Manager to lead the electronics function within our Systems team at IonQ. You will lead a team of three electronics engineers and grow it as our programmes scale. The team designs, builds and tests the electronics subsystems behind our mission to build the most performant quantum computers.

This is a player-coach role, with roughly 60% of your time spent leading the team and 40% on hands-on design work. You will set the technical direction for our electronics deliverables and build a team that can deliver them reliably, from experimental prototypes to rack-ready production systems.

Responsibilities 

You will own the electronics roadmap for current and next-generation quantum systems. That covers schematic capture and PCB layout through to board and system-level test, and the drive architecture for QPU designs.

You will balance hands-on technical leadership with people management, planning and coordination across teams. As the main electronics contact for the physics, firmware, mechanical and systems teams, you will turn complex physical requirements into clear, achievable engineering plans, and you will keep improving the tooling, workflow and capability of the team.Key responsibilities include: 

  • Team leadership: Lead and develop a team of three electronics engineers and play a key role in growing it through hiring. Set clear goals, run regular 1:1s and performance reviews, and build a culture of technical excellence and accountability.
  • Technical direction: Own the architecture of the electronics subsystems, including mixed-signal design, high-speed digital and signal integrity. Approve key design decisions and lead design reviews.
  • Delivery and planning: Plan, prioritise and track electronics workstreams against programme milestones, managing resourcing, schedules, risks and dependencies, and report progress to stakeholders.
  • Quality and process: Set and improve design standards, review processes, verification and test strategy (simulation, bench test, system integration) and documentation practices.
  • Productisation: Lead the move from experimental prototypes to robust, manufacturable, rack-ready production systems, working with suppliers and contract manufacturers as needed.

Requirements 

To succeed, you will need around ten years of experience in electronics design, with a strong background in high-speed and mixed-signal electronics, proven experience leading engineers and a track record of taking hardware from concept through prototype to production on schedule. You should be able to give credible technical guidance while growing the team around you, and bring a high level of attention to detail to your own work and to the designs you review.

You will be comfortable in a fast-moving, highly technical environment and know when to use waterfall or agile delivery in a hardware setting. Experience with Jira and Smartsheet, exposure to cryogenic environments, RF/microwave engineering (up to 500 MHz) or Python-based test automation, and familiarity with the Sinara/ARTIQ ecosystem in a quantum or physics research setting would all be an advantage.


You’d be a great fit with:

  • Engineering leadership experience: A track record of managing or technically leading electronics engineers, including hiring, mentoring and performance management.
  • Strong hardware design background: Hands-on experience with mixed-signal and high-speed digital design, SPICE modelling and lab verification (oscilloscopes, spectrum analysers).
  • Altium expertise: Experience with complex schematics, rigid-flex designs and advanced signal-integrity constraints, and the ability to review and guide others' designs.
  • FPGA and high-performance hardware: Familiarity with Xilinx/Intel toolchains (Vivado/Quartus) and carriers such as the BittWare XUP series or Sinara/ARTIQ hardware.
  • High-speed interfaces: Knowledge of SFP+/QSFP-DD interfaces, 10/100G Ethernet and high-speed differential pair routing.

Posted base salary figures are subject to change as new market data becomes available. Our benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, matching 401(k), unlimited PTO and paid holidays, parental/adoption leave, legal insurance, and a home technology stipend. title: Energy Procurement & Policy
descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The team

Mistral Cloud builds and operates the infrastructure that powers Mistral's AI. The Data Centers team signs long-term leases for data center capacity developed by third-party operators, sources the GPUs that fill those halls, and runs the workloads that train and serve Mistral's models. Today the team is around 40 people, mainly based in Paris with some remote members, and operates roughly 200 MW of existing capacity across France. Key partners include Éclairion in France and EcoDC in Sweden, which is currently delivering Mistral's first Swedish data center.

The team sits at the center of an ambitious roadmap: Mistral has publicly committed to securing one gigawatt of data center capacity globally by 2030. With 200 MW already online, roughly 800 MW remain to be secured over the next five years. Every megawatt needs power, and power is this role's domain.

The Role

Mistral's data centers will consume hundreds of megawatts of electricity. This hire makes sure that power is reliable and affordable. You will define and execute Mistral's energy procurement strategy: structuring agreements with utilities, hedging against volatile spot prices, and tracking the regulatory changes that affect where and how data centers can be powered. The role also touches energy policy and community relations in the regions where Mistral operates.

This is a hybrid seat. Roughly half of the work is commercial: procurement contracts, hedging instruments, and price risk management. The other half is policy and positioning: monitoring regulation, engaging with grid operators and local authorities, and helping Mistral build the social license to operate large data centers across Europe.

What You Will Do

  • Define and execute Mistral's energy procurement strategy across European data center sites

  • Negotiate power purchase agreements and procurement contracts with utilities

  • Structure hedging agreements to limit exposure to volatile spot power prices

  • Monitor energy regulation and policy developments that affect data center siting, grid connection, and power pricing

  • Engage with grid operators, regulators, and local communities in regions where Mistral builds and operates data centers

What We're Looking For

  • You have procured energy at scale. You have structured power purchase agreements, utility contracts, or hedging instruments for industrial or infrastructure-scale consumers.

  • You understand European energy markets. You know how power pricing, grid connection, and regulation work across the markets where Mistral operates.

  • You can read a regulatory brief. You have tracked and interpreted energy or infrastructure policy and translated it into commercial implications.

  • You communicate across disciplines. You work effectively with engineers, finance, legal, and external stakeholders, and can explain complex energy concepts to non-specialists.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

title: Engineering Director, EU
descriptionHtml:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

📍London or Remote (UK) or Barcelona, Spain (Hybrid) 

Engineering at Monzo

Monzo has successfully launched in Ireland and is expanding across Europe. We're now entering the next phase of our journey: building and scaling a multi-market European bank.

The EU Engineering organisation sits at the centre of that ambition. We are responsible for helping Monzo launch, grow and operate across Europe, navigating everything from product-market fit and customer growth to regulatory requirements, localisation and operational scale.

Unlike most engineering organisations at Monzo, EU does not own a single product area. We work horizontally across the company, partnering with teams across Payments, Core Banking, Growth, Wealth, Customer Operations, Fincrime, Platform and many others to bring Monzo's products to new markets and deliver great customer experiences locally.

As an Engineering Director, you'll lead a distributed engineering organisation across the UK, Spain and remote locations. You'll partner closely with Product, Design, Data, Operations, Risk, Compliance and executive stakeholders to solve complex problems that span organisational boundaries.

Success in this role comes through influence, relationships and organisational leadership as much as execution. You'll need to build alignment across a wide range of teams, create clarity in ambiguity, and help Monzo discover what works in new markets while establishing the foundations that allow us to scale across Europe.

This is one of Monzo's most strategically important areas and a unique opportunity to help build a European bank from the ground up.

What you’ll work on

  • Lead a distributed engineering organisation spanning multiple squads, markets and countries.
  • Build and develop Engineering Managers, Senior Engineering Managers and senior technical leaders.
  • Partner with Product, Design, Data, Research, Operations, Risk and Compliance leaders to define and execute Monzo's European strategy.
  • Drive alignment and execution across numerous collectives to ensure Europe receives the capabilities it needs to succeed.
  • Shape how Monzo approaches market expansion, localisation, regulatory requirements and multi-market product development.
  • Influence priorities and outcomes across teams that do not directly report to you.
  • Create clarity and momentum in highly ambiguous problem spaces where ownership and solutions are not always obvious.
  • Design and evolve organisational structures, operating models and planning processes that allow Monzo to scale effectively across Europe.
  • Help identify and validate product-market fit in new markets while balancing short-term delivery and long-term strategic investments.
  • Partner closely with executive leadership to shape the future of Monzo's European business.

You should apply if

  • You have experience leading large engineering organisations through other leaders, including Engineering Managers, Senior Engineering Managers and senior individual contributors.
  • You have successfully operated in highly complex organisations where outcomes depend on collaboration across many teams and functions.
  • You are exceptional at building relationships and influencing without direct authority.
  • You can navigate ambiguity and create clarity where goals, ownership or priorities are not yet fully defined.
  • You have experience scaling organisations through periods of rapid growth, organisational change or market expansion.
  • You enjoy solving organisational and business problems, not just technical ones.You can balance strategy and execution, translating ambitious goals into tangible outcomes.
  • You are comfortable making decisions in environments where there is rarely a perfect answer.
  • You have a strong track record of building high-performing leadership teams and developing future leaders.
  • You are energised by the challenge of building something new and helping shape the future of Monzo's international expansion.

The interview process

After an informal ~30 min recruiter call our interview process involves 2 main stages: 

  1. Initial Call (1 hour) You'll meet with one of our senior engineering leaders. They'll ask you about your previous experience, in particular people leadership, product delivery and technical leadership. They’ll ask example based questions (‘Tell me about a time when…’)
  2. Loop Stage - This is one stage with 4 interviews (totalling 4 hours) split between a collaboration with one of our engineers on a technical exercise, as well as execution and leadership interviews.

At all stages we’ll create space for you to ask as many questions as you have, you’re interviewing us as well!

Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. You will have the chance to speak to our recruitment team at various points during your process but if you do have any specific questions ahead of this please contact us on

How we work 💻:

Locations & Flexible Working (If you're in the UK) : 

Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles. 

We value meeting in person but there’s no pressure to come into the office, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs. ✨

Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches & treat Thursdays 🍽️. Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.

We are looking for a skilled and passionate Engineering Manager to join our Alwin Agents Runtime Team in the Amsterdam office. Working in a bootstrapped and profitable scaleup, you'll have the unique opportunity to lead a team building the intelligence layer that automates the assurance lifecycle and brings AI directly into the workflows of auditors worldwide.


Why DataSnipper?

The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust.

We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.

For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it.

And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers. Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.

If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way.

title: Engineering Manager
descriptionHtml:
We have real traction and proven scale, and we're now setting up how engineering works for our next wave of European growth. You would lead one of the teams doing it, and shape the practices the others follow.

ABOUT THE ROLE

You would lead one of our product engineering teams: what it ships, how it runs, and how the people in it grow. Product and engineering together are ~25 people, so there is nowhere to hide and nothing you can't reach.

It's a hands-on role. One week you're in a design review, the next - in a few Claude-enabled contributions, the next - in performance conversations, and most weeks - all of that combined. You should love zooming in and out, from feedback on an API spec to a quarter's priorities. Your team trusts your technical judgement because you still use it.

Beyond your team, you would shape how engineering works at Insify together with the other Engineering Managers, a Staff Engineer and the VP Engineering: architecture, product discovery, how engineers grow.


What you'll be doing
  • Leading a team of product engineers end to end: what you ship, how it performs in production, and who you hire and grow to get there
  • Bringing architecture and product thinking into the team's daily work, so that new product demands turn into platform capabilities that scale across countries and insurance products, rather than one-off builds
  • Running product discovery with your team: working with the Insurance, Operations and Growth teams on what to build, and saying no when the answer is no
  • Shaping company-wide engineering practices alongside the other Engineering Managers: ways of working, architecture & technology practices, the growth framework
  • Challenging our ideas and bringing your own. We encourage each other to act this way, so you can expect the same from others

    • What you'll need
  • You've managed a team of engineers before, including hiring, feedback and growing people. It doesn't have to be for long, but it has to be real and you have to want more of it
  • Years of hands-on experience designing and running distributed systems, including time spent maintaining what you designed. You can still carry an architecture discussion and review a design, and your team would trust your judgement on it
  • A track record of shaping what gets built, not only how: you've run or driven product discovery, cut scope, and can show the decisions that followed
  • Ownership & impact instinct - when needed you go beyond your team's boundaries to get to results
  • You set the bar for AI adoption on your team. You use it to real effect in your own work, you're honest about where it helped and where it fell short, and you're the first to try new tools, bringing the ones that stick to your engineers.

    • Nice to have
  • You are eager to scale your experience beyond your team - to create wider organisational impact
  • Experience building B2B products, especially in insurance & fintech
  • Experience working on a product distributed across different country markets
  • Experience with TypeScript and AWS

    • Our stack
  • TypeScript across the board, running on AWS with infrastructure as code, in a single monorepo.

    • None of this is a hard requirement, and you don't need to know all of our stack. We care more about how you reason about systems and teams than which tools you have used. Strong on most of it? Apply.


    We offer
  • Competitive compensation. We offer a salary in the range of 85k-110k EUR plus performance-based equity grants
  • Hybrid. 3 days in the office, 2 from home, up to 4 weeks a year from abroad, 25 holiday days
  • Pension. 6% employer contribution
  • Wellbeing budget. €50 net a month via Epassi, from the gym to takeaway, rolls over
  • Learning and coaching. Internal leadership programs and coaching
  • Central Amsterdam office. Shared lunches, dogs, Friday drinks, high-spec MacBook Pro

    • HOW WE HIRE

    Five conversations, each with a clear purpose, and you hear where you stand after every one:

    • Leadership. We look at your experience with performance management, personal development and building teams.
    • Code Review. You review a feature with two of our engineers.
    • System Design. An architecture problem close to what we deal with.
    • Values Interview. We look at your approach to work, and how it adds to our Values.
    • Meet the Founder.

    You get the outcome within three days of your last round, with specific feedback either way.

    ABOUT INSIFY

    Insify is a high-growth scale-up backed by €43M in total funding from world-class investors like Accel, Munich Re Ventures, and Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg. In five years, we've expanded from the Netherlands into France and Germany, and we're just getting started. Our mission: become the European leader in AI-powered SME insurance.

    We aren't just building a company; we're leading a revolution. Our culture is intense, high-stakes, and mission-driven. We hire smart, ambitious "owners" who possess a relentless drive to win. This is an environment for those who thrive on challenges, value intellectual honesty, and share our mindset of becoming a global category leader.

We bring that same bias for speed, scale, and high standards to one of the most structurally broken experiences in financial services. Together, we combine that deep fintech and e-commerce expertise with cutting-edge AI to stay ahead of the curve.

title: Engineering Manager - CDI Paris - Theodo HealthTech
descriptionHtml:
L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès
Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean.

Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA. Chez Theodo HealthTech, l'entité experte en santé, nous accompagnons tous les acteurs de la santé dans le développement des dispositifs médicaux digitaux sur-mesure. Grâce à notre expérience du Lean et de la tech, combinées à notre connaissance de la santé, nous concevons et développons des dispositifs médicaux numériques qui s'intègrent dans le parcours de soins des patients (thérapies digitales - DTx, essais cliniques virtualisés, parcours de soins digitalisés). Notre but est de réaliser des produits qui changent la vie de leurs utilisateurs, qu'ils soient soignants ou patients.
Ton équipe : Chez Theodo, les techs travaillent en équipes projet, constituées en fonction des besoins de chaque client, réunissant Software Engineers, Tech Lead et Product Manager. Ensemble, ils collaborent étroitement avec le client, avec des échanges réguliers pour partager vos avancées, approfondir la compréhension de son problème et faire évoluer le produit au plus près des besoins de ses utilisateurs. En tant qu’Engineering Manager, ton rôle est de manager jusqu’à 4 tech leads, soit de chapeauter la réussite de 4 projets, en binôme avec un(e) Group Project Manager. Tes futures missions : Le besoin actuel porte sur des missions “grands-comptes” avec des produits et architectures complexes, développées par plusieurs squads de Theodo : - Manager & faire progresser les Tech Leads : tu accompagnes 1 à 4 Tech Leads dans leur montée en compétence et leur épanouissement. - Assurer le delivery technique : tu garantis la qualité du code (3S : stabilité, sécurité, vitesse), la tenue des jalons et la robustesse de l’architecture. - Contribuer au développement business : tu participes aux discussions stratégiques avec nos clients (DSI, sponsors…), tu aides à identifier des opportunités et tu es acteur de l’avant-vente avec nos sales. Les problématiques et les technos sont très différentes d’un projet à l’autre, voici quelques exemples : - Hub Santé : lancé par l’Agence du Numérique en Santé en 2024, vise à connecter en temps réel les 83 SAMU, SMUR, SDIS et autres acteurs de l’urgence, dans un écosystème historiquement fragmenté. Accompagnée par une équipe de 3 experts Theodo, l’ANS a déployé une plateforme nationale d’interopérabilité permettant une coordination critique plus fluide et sécurisée. Résultats : +10 SAMU connectés dès la phase pilote, interopérabilité effective sur plusieurs périmètres et conformité HDS maintenue. - Vidal : référence centenaire de l’information médicale, a développé avec Theodo un assistant médical basé sur l’IA générative pour fournir aux professionnels de santé des réponses fiables en un temps record et sécuriser la prescription. En 8 semaines, une équipe de 4 experts Theodo a conçu un POC de chatbot RAG connecté à la base Vidal, capable de réduire le temps de recherche tout en garantissant traçabilité et fiabilité des sources. Objectif : renforcer la confiance des praticiens et faire entrer Vidal dans l’ère du service médical “fonctionnel”. Tes perspectives d’évolutions : Perspectives d’évolution moyen terme (1 - 2 ans) : - Manageriale : VP Tech ou Group Manager - Technique : Architecte senior - Business/Influence : Thought Leader (animer une communauté tech) ou Intrapreneur (porter une nouvelle offre) Une méthodologie basée sur l’apprentissage continu : Chez Theodo, nous avons construit notre approche tech autour d’une conviction forte : on développe d’abord les personnes, avant de développer les produits. Notre Lean Tech® System met l’accent sur l’apprentissage continu : tu évolueras dans un environnement qui investit sur le long terme, où l’objectif est de te permettre de progresser chaque jour, tout en construisant des produits utiles et performants pour nos clients. Profil recherché : - 7 à 14 ans d’expérience professionnelle, avec une expérience confirmée en management d’équipes tech et en environnement ESN / conseil. - Basé(e) en région parisienne, avec une préférence pour une présence majoritaire au bureau, attendue pour un rôle stratégique et managérial. Hard skills - Solide expertise technologique (Java / Spring Boot et/ou Angular) permettant d’être crédible et légitime auprès des équipes, sans être attendu·e sur le code au quotidien. - Capacité à concevoir des architectures évolutives et à arbitrer des choix techniques dans des contextes grands comptes complexes. - Expérience significative en management d’équipes techniques, avec la capacité à débloquer des Tech - Leads sur des problématiques techniques complexes. - Capacité d’analyse et de résolution de problèmes complexes, avec un impact transverse dans l’organisation. - Intérêt pour l’IA générative et son usage dans la conception et le développement de produits digitaux. Soft skills - Leadership affirmé et posture pédagogique pour embarquer, inspirer et faire progresser des équipes exigeantes. - Orientation marquée business et création de valeur : chez Theodo, nous ne faisons pas de la tech pour la tech. - Aisance relationnelle et communicationnelle, avec la capacité d’adresser tous niveaux d’interlocuteurs, y compris C-level, et de mener des conversations exigeantes. Le process de recrutement : - Call de qualification (30 min) avec un membre de l’équipe recrutement - Cultural fit (1h) avec le même recruteur - Test technique de refactoring (à la maison + débrief 1h) - Entretien modélisation (1h) - Simulation vente d’architecture à un DSI (1h) - Final avec un dirigeant - Prise de référencePourquoi rejoindre Theodo HealthTech ? Son objectif : t’épauler dans ton quotidien et parler objectifs de carrière via des séances de coaching hebdomadaires. 🎯 Participation à des projets associatifs grâce à la Fondation Theodo (Ada Tech School, Code Phoenix, Article 1…) 🎉 Soirées mensuelles, keynotes et week-end d’entreprise annuel Le package : 📈 Actionnariat salarié pour être associé à la réussite du groupe 💸 Prime d’intéressement indexée sur la croissance de Theodo 🖥 Budget équipement (ordinateur, smartphone, écouteurs…) 🧒 Des avantages fournis par notre CSE (sport avec Gymlib,...) 🏖 5 semaines + 8 à 12 RTT/an 🩺 Mutuelle (SideCare) prise en charge à 50% 🍽 Carte ticket-restaurants Swile 🧒 Aides et places en crèche réservées Prêt à nous rejoindre ?

title: Engineering Manager - Compilers
descriptionHtml:
About Fractile

Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.

 

The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems.

The role

Fractile is building a full-stack AI accelerator from the ground up, and the compiler team sits at the heart of how we deliver performance. As the Engineering Manager for Compilers, you will build and lead a team of 10+ engineers developing the compiler stack for our novel AI acceleration hardware, with direct responsibility for enabling industry-leading LLM inference performance on Fractile's accelerators. This is a hands-on technical leadership role in a fast-moving, collaborative environment where the compiler team works closely with hardware, driver, runtime and ML engineers across the stack. If you want to shape the architecture of a compiler from first principles, build a world-class team around it, and have your work directly determine the performance of next-generation AI hardware, this is the role.

What we’re looking for:

  • Proven track record of leadership experience managing a high-performance development team and delivering consistently outstanding outcomes.

  • Proven experience in compiler development, with experience of machine learning compilers and industry standard technologies such as MLIR or TVM being a significant advantage.

  • Up-to-date knowledge of machine learning techniques and technologies

  • A good understanding of computer architecture and performance optimisation techniques.

  • Excellent C/C++ skills and solid experience of industry standard development tools and technologies.

  • A creative and innovative mindset, and a willingness to take ownership and drive results in a fast-paced environment.

What you’re signing up for:

This is a young company doing hard things, at the intersection of novel silicon and the software stack that makes it useful. You'll be building and leading a compiler team as the hardware it targets is still taking shape, which means making architectural decisions against a specification first, then a simulator, then early silicon. The IR design, the lowering strategy, the execution model: you'll help define all of it before you can run it on real hardware. That takes comfort with ambiguity and the ability to make good calls with incomplete information. If that sounds frustrating, this probably isn't the role. If that sounds like the interesting part, we should talk.

The boundaries here are soft by design. The compiler team works closely with hardware architects, kernel engineers, runtime teams and ML researchers. You'll need to understand enough of what sits above and below your layer to make good decisions at the boundary, and to build a team that can do the same. That breadth is a feature of the job, not a distraction from it.

You'll be there when the first model runs end to end on Fractile silicon. When the lowering strategy you helped design produces a result the hardware team didn't think was possible yet. When the team you hired and grew ships something that goes into every rack we sell.

We want a team that reflects the world it's building for, and we welcome applicants from every background, including those whose path here hasn't been straight. We care that you're energised by this kind of work, that you build and develop great engineers, and that you make the people around you better.

Come build it with us.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary: A competitive salary reflective of your experience and the specialist nature of the role.

  • Equity & Ownership: meaningful equity so everyone shares in the value creation

  • Benefits: Private Medical, Dental and Vision, Contributory Pension, 25 Days holiday plus bank holidays and Life/Critical Illness Insurance.

  • Diverse & fun office: we believe the hardest problems get solved by the broadest range of minds. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a diverse team and building an inclusive environment.

Fractile is seeking to increase the clock speed of global progress, one chip at a time. We’ve recently raised $220M from investors including Founders Fund and Accel and our most important work lies ahead. Join us!

 

Export controls

Our work involves technologies subject to UK, US and other international export control regulations. Certain roles may require additional eligibility checks to ensure compliance with applicable law. We'll be transparent about this throughout the hiring process.

title: Enterprise Account Executive - French (f/h/x)
descriptionHtml:
Description

En tant qu’Enterprise Account Executive (F/H/X) pour la France, vous contribuerez directement à la croissance de Contentful en pilotant l’ensemble du cycle de vente, de la prospection jusqu’à la signature. Vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la génération de nouveaux revenus et l’identification d’opportunités d’upsell auprès de nos clients actuels et de nouveaux clients.

Vous contribuerez également aux initiatives d’accompagnement et d’adoption de nos solutions par les clients, tout en adoptant une approche commerciale consultative. Vous serez capable de dialoguer aussi bien avec des experts techniques qu’avec des décideurs et dirigeants métier.

En collaboration étroite avec nos équipes Customer Experience, BDR, Partenariats et Marketing, vous développerez et fidéliserez notre portefeuille de clients sur le marché français.

Ce que vous ferez concrètement 

  • Collaborer avec notre équipe commerciale transverse afin d’accompagner les clients actuels et potentiels dans l’adoption des différentes fonctionnalités et solutions de Contentful.
  • Identifier, positionner, négocier et conclure des opportunités d’expansion auprès de nos clients existants.
  • Atteindre les objectifs commerciaux trimestriels et annuels en élaborant une stratégie de compte et un pipeline commercial, en pilotant les processus internes et clients, en assurant le suivi des activités commerciales, en développant votre connaissance du marché et de la concurrence, en présentant nos solutions aux clients et en élaborant des propositions commerciales.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes BDR afin d’identifier les clients potentiels et de qualifier les leads.
  • Prospecter et développer de nouvelles opportunités commerciales sur un territoire défini. Effectuer des recherches, identifier les interlocuteurs clés et qualifier les leads entrants afin de développer de nouvelles relations commerciales. Entretenir ensuite des relations à forte valeur ajoutée avec les principaux décideurs en devenant un véritable partenaire de confiance.
  • Piloter les demandes de RFI/RFQ en collaboration avec les équipes internes de Contentful et les équipes clientes.
  • Faire évoluer et optimiser notre modèle « land-and-expand » en collaboration avec les équipes Sales, Partenariats, Marketing et Customer Experience.
  • Identifier les enjeux liés aux expériences digitales de nos prospects et clients, et mettre en évidence le ROI de Contentful pour y répondre, afin de privilégier une approche commerciale fondée sur la valeur.
  • Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les Solution Engineers afin d’identifier les problématiques techniques et les opportunités associées.
  • Élaborer des propositions commerciales, positionner des structures tarifaires complexes et négocier efficacement les contrats ainsi que les conditions nécessaires à la conclusion des affaires.
  • Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes Customer Experience et Marketing afin de garantir que les bonnes pratiques Contentful soient partagées et mises en œuvre auprès des clients concernés.

Description

Qualified est la plateforme de marketing agentique propulsée par l'IA de Salesforce, hébergeant Piper — l'agent SDR IA n°1 — qui engage, qualifie et convertit de manière autonome les leads B2B entrants en pipeline à grande échelle, 24h/24 et 7j/7. Salesforce a récemment fait l'acquisition de Qualified, et nous développons actuellement sa fonction go-to-market pour la région EMEA en partant de zéro. Il s'agit d'une opportunité rare de rejoindre une région pour une entreprise en forte croissance et récemment acquise, alors qu'elle s'intègre au sein de l'un des plus grands éditeurs de logiciels d'entreprise au monde — combinant l'agilité et le rythme d'une start-up avec l'échelle et les ressources de Salesforce.

Nous recherchons un Enterprise Account Executive pour stimuler les revenus issus de nouveaux clients à travers la France, en pilotant l'ensemble du cycle de vente sur un territoire défini. Vous serez l'un des premiers Enterprise AEs sur le terrain pour Qualified, ce qui signifie que vous aurez une influence directe sur la façon dont la stratégie territoriale et les playbooks de vente prennent forme, au moment où cette activité s'établit au sein de l'écosystème plus large Agentforce/Data360 de Salesforce.

Ce rôle convient à une personne qui s'épanouit dans l'ambiguïté et apprécie le défi de construire quelque chose de nouveau — quelqu'un qui voit une opportunité là où d'autres pourraient voir de l'incertitude. Faire partie d'une toute nouvelle équipe apporte son propre mélange stimulant de liberté et de défis.

Ainsi, parallèlement à la croissance des revenus, vous apporterez curiosité, débrouillardise et un esprit collaboratif — en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec la direction d'Agentforce, les AEs Data Cloud et des équipes transversales plus larges pour aider à établir la place de Qualified au cœur de la stratégie go-to-market de Salesforce.

L'expérience En tant qu'Enterprise Account Executive, vous serez responsable de l'élaboration et de l'exécution d'un plan stratégique de compte/territoire complet, ainsi que du pilotage des ventes sur un territoire et/ou une liste de comptes définis afin d'atteindre les objectifs de chiffre d'affaires. Vous apporterez une approche axée sur les solutions pour vendre, en aidant les prospects à comprendre comment nos produits dans le secteur du marketing conversationnel et de la génération de pipeline répondent à leurs besoins professionnels uniques. En tant qu'AE de terrain, vous faciliterez chaque étape du cycle de vente, de la découverte initiale à la négociation tarifaire, en passant par la présentation de notre solution.

Ce que vous ferez concrètement

  • Être un expert de la phase de découverte et un partenaire commercial stratégique pour les prospects, tout en gérant l'intégralité du cycle de vente.

  • Prospecter, qualifier et conclure de nouveaux contrats avec des grandes entreprises (+2500 collaborateurs), en vous appuyant sur votre vision stratégique pour démontrer la valeur de Qualified.

  • Travailler de manière active sur vos comptes cibles identifiés tout en développant et maintenant constamment un pipeline de ventes solide.

  • Orchestrer le cycle de vente pour vos prospects et savoir quand faire intervenir les bonnes parties prenantes.

  • Collaborer de manière transversale avec des partenaires clés tels que le Marketing, l'Ingénierie Avant-Vente, le Produit et le Customer Success.

  • Comprendre la concurrence pour vous positionner de manière stratégique sur notre marché.

Expérience requise

Pour réussir dans ce poste, vous disposez de :

  • 4 ans ou plus d’expérience dans la vente d’une plateforme technologique.
  • 4 ans ou plus d’expérience dans un poste avec objectifs commerciaux (quota), idéalement sur le marché français.
  • Une bonne connaissance de la vente et du positionnement de solutions techniques SaaS et/ou PaaS auprès de clients.
  • 2 ans ou plus d’expérience dans le développement et l’expansion de comptes clients existants dans un environnement SaaS et/ou PaaS.
  • Une expérience démontrée dans la vente de contrats de 150 000 $ ou plus auprès d’organisations générant plus d’1 milliard de dollars de chiffre d’affaires.
  • Une maîtrise courante du français  et de l’anglais.

Ce serait un plus

  • Connaissance des technologies API-first et cloud native.
  • Une expérience préalable dans le domaine des CMS (systèmes de gestion de contenu).

More details about our company benefits can be found at the following link: https://www.salesforcebenefits.com.

title: Enterprise Architect - Salesforce Marketing Cloud
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

VML is a global creative company that combines brand experience, customer experience, and commerce to create connected brands that drive growth. Guided by a Human First philosophy, VML is known for its innovative work for brands and consistently ranks among the world’s leading creative companies, including the WARC Creative 100. VML’s global network spans 55+ markets with principal offices in Buenos Aires, Kansas City, London, New York, São Paulo, Shanghai and Singapore. 

VML is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel. 

For more information, please visit www.vml.com and follow along on  LinkedIn #WeAreVML.

Do you thrive on shaping the strategic technological future of the world’s leading brands? Are you a visionary architect who can orchestrate complex MarTech ecosystems to deliver hyper-personalised customer experiences at scale? Can you translate ambitious business objectives into scalable, compliant, and future-proof enterprise architectures? 

If you are a strategic technology leader with a consultancy mindset, strong stakeholder management skills, and a passion for driving innovation across enterprise MarTech landscapes, then you might be the Enterprise Architect we’re looking for. 

What will your day look like? 

As an Enterprise Architect, you will be the strategic technical leader responsible for defining, evolving, and governing enterprise-wide MarTech architecture for our clients. You will operate at the intersection of business, technology, data, and innovation, translating business strategies into scalable architectural roadmaps that drive measurable business outcomes. 

You will act as a trusted advisor to both clients and internal stakeholders, ensuring that enterprise marketing ecosystems align with long-term business objectives while supporting innovation, operational excellence, scalability, and profitability. 

You will also act as an ambassador of VML MAP values, principles, and ways of working, contributing to the growth and evolution of the wider Tech & Data practice. 

More specifically, your responsibilities will include: 

Strategic Vision & Enterprise Roadmaps 

  • Define and maintain enterprise MarTech architectural roadmaps aligned to both short-term and long-term business goals. 
  • Translate complex business strategies into scalable technical visions and actionable transformation plans. 
  • Align enterprise architecture with broader business and marketing objectives to support growth and customer-centricity. 
  • Support clients in defining future-state architecture and transformation strategies. 

Enterprise Architecture & MarTech Orchestration 

  • Design and orchestrate complex enterprise MarTech ecosystems involving multiple platforms, marketing clouds, vendors, integrations, and data sources. 
  • Define scalable architectural blueprints and integration patterns across disparate systems and cloud environments. 
  • Ensure interoperability, scalability, performance, reliability, and operational efficiency across the wider technology landscape. 
  • Simplify and optimise enterprise ecosystems while maintaining alignment with strategic business goals 

Data, Governance, Privacy & Security 

  • Define enterprise-wide data architecture strategies, governance principles, and integration standards. 
  • Ensure compliance with data privacy regulations such as GDPR and CCPA through Privacy by Design principles. 
  • Establish architectural governance frameworks, standards, and best practices. 
  • Ensure enterprise solutions maintain strong security, scalability, and data quality standards. 

Innovation & Emerging Technologies 

  • Drive innovation initiatives and continuously evaluate emerging MarTech, AI, and cloud technologies. 
  • Identify opportunities to improve client ecosystems, operational maturity, and customer experiences through modern technology adoption. 
  • Stay up to date with evolving industry trends, enterprise architecture patterns, and best practices 
  • Champion AI adoption and innovation initiatives where relevant. 

Consultancy, Client Leadership & Business Growth 

  • Act as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders, including CMOs, Enterprise Architects, and business leadership teams. 
  • Influence strategic decision-making by connecting business needs with enterprise technology opportunities 
  • Support pre-sales, strategic consulting, innovation initiatives, and transformation programs. 
  • Partner with Account, Strategy, and Solution Consulting teams to identify growth opportunities and shape enterprise solution approaches. 
  • Balance technical excellence with commercial pragmatism to drive both client value and sustainable delivery outcomes. 

Cross-Capability Collaboration & Technical Leadership 

  • Operate across cross-functional and cross-capability teams, including Tech & Data, Experience, Strategy, Paid Media, Marketing Operations, Solution Consulting, and Account capabilities. 
  • Provide technical leadership across large-scale and complex client engagements. 
  • Mentor and support Solutions Architects, Technical Architects, Developers, and other technical specialists. 
  • Drive alignment across global teams, portfolios, and capabilities to promote reusable enterprise patterns and best practices. 
  • Contribute to communities, guilds, knowledge-sharing initiatives, and capability growth across VML MAP. 

Operationalisation & Continuous Improvement 

  • Support the stabilisation, optimisation, and operationalisation of enterprise MarTech ecosystems. 
  • Ensure enterprise solutions deliver measurable business outcomes and long-term operational success. 
  • Oversee KPIs, performance metrics, and ROI expectations across enterprise platforms. 
  • Participate in resolving complex technical and operational challenges across client ecosystems. 

Who are you going to work with? 

You will operate at the intersection of business and technology, engaging with a broad spectrum of stakeholders internally and externally. 

You will work closely with: 

  • C-suite stakeholders, including CMOs and enterprise leadership teams. 
  • Client architects, technical teams, and external vendors. 
  • Internal Account, Strategy, Experience, Paid Media, Marketing Operations, and Solution Consulting teams. 
  • Technical Architects, Solutions Architects, Developers, Data Engineers, TPMs, and other Tech & Data specialists. 
  • Communities, Guilds, and innovation initiatives across the wider VML MAP organisation. 

At VML MAP, we value diversity, collaboration, innovation, and continuous growth. We empower our leaders to bring both strategic thinking and personal leadership into their day-to-day work while helping others grow and succeed. 

What do you bring to the table? 

As a person, you are a strategic and influential technology leader with strong emotional intelligence and consultancy capabilities. You can navigate ambiguity, influence senior stakeholders, and connect business strategy with enterprise technology direction. 

You are highly collaborative, self-driven, innovative, and commercially aware, with a passion for mentoring others and contributing to the wider growth of the organisation. 

You are comfortable operating across both strategic transformation discussions and complex enterprise technology challenges. 

In addition, you have: 

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in technical architecture, with extensive experience operating in Enterprise Architect roles within MarTech ecosystems 
  • Deep expertise across Salesforce Marketing Cloud and broader enterprise MarTech platforms such as Data Cloud, CDPs, CRM, Analytics, CMS, AdTech, and cloud ecosystems. 
  • Proven experience designing and governing enterprise-wide marketing technology landscapes across multiple vendors and cloud environments. 
  • Strong understanding of enterprise architecture principles, integration patterns, API strategies, cloud solutions, scalability, reliability, and performance optimisation. 
  • Experience defining enterprise data architecture, governance models, and privacy-by-design frameworks. 
  • Demonstrated experience influencing business outcomes through enterprise technology strategy and consultancy. 
  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, including experience engaging with executive leadership and senior client stakeholders. 
  • Experience supporting pre-sales, innovation initiatives, strategic consulting, and business development activities. 
  • Passion for mentoring, knowledge sharing, and growing technical communities. 
  • Strong understanding of the digital agency landscape and consultancy-driven client delivery models. 
  • Experience working across global teams and cross-functional organisations. 
  • Familiarity with enterprise architecture frameworks such as TOGAF and their practical application within MarTech ecosystems. 

A leader in personalised customer experiences 

VML MAP is a world-leading Centre of Excellence that helps businesses humanise the relationship between brands and customers through hyper-personalisation at scale, marketing automation, CRM, and data-driven experiences. 

With the brain of a consultancy, the heart of an agency, and the power of technology and data, we work with some of the world’s most admired brands to help them become truly customer-centric organisations. 

As an Enterprise Architect, you will play a critical role in shaping and evolving enterprise MarTech landscapes, driving innovation, solving complex integration challenges, and aligning technology ecosystems with strategic business outcomes. 

Together, we are 1000+ technology specialists, data scientists, strategic thinkers, consultants, operations experts, and creative minds from 55+ nationalities. 

A global network 

We are part of the global VML network that encompasses more than 30,000 employees across 150+ offices in 60+ markets, each contributing to a culture that values connection, belonging, and the power of differences. 

#LI-EMEA 

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office an average of four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

WPP (VML) is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

California residents should read our California Recruitment Privacy Notice. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.
