title: Senior Social Commerce Manager
descriptionHtml:
About THG Ingenuity 

THG Ingenuity is a proprietary Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) technology, robotics, and operations platform built for global ecommerce. Developed through more than two decades of operating ecommerce and retail services at scale, its software and automation capabilities have been engineered, tested, and refined through the real-world demands of managing complex commerce operations. Today, THG Ingenuity provides an integrating operating environment that enables brands to intelligently optimise the entire commerce lifecycle from browsing and checkout to AI inventory management and forecasting, automated fulfilment, carrier control, and customer experience. The platform comprises: 

  • THG Fulfil: The fulfilment operating system for global ecommerce. Delivered via a proprietary SaaS and Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model, THG Fulfil orchestrates every stage of checkout, fulfilment, delivery, and customer experience through an integrated system. 
  • THG Studios: The UK's most innovative creative hub, helping brands create content that connects, experiences that engage, and IP that scales, all from its end-to-end, in-house facilities.  
  • THG Commerce: A cloud-native technology stack enabling retailers and brands to create intelligent, AI-powered, digital shopping experiences, while integrated marketplace and social commerce functionality allows brands to reach customers across every sales channel 

With its expertise in building and scaling brands, THG Ingenuity is uniquely positioned to bring pertinent, pragmatic, and global know-how across all aspects of commerce. 

 About the Role 

The Senior Social Commerce Manager is a senior, client-facing role within THG Ingenuity’s Partnership Marketing team, responsible for the strategy and delivery of TikTok Shop across our client portfolio. 

Reporting into the Head of Partnership Marketing, you’ll own what we recommend to our TikTok Shop clients and make sure we deliver it brilliantly - setting the strategy for each account, monitoring performance and driving it forward, building strong client relationships, and holding a high bar on the quality of every service we deliver. 

This is a role for someone who combines deep TikTok Shop expertise with commercial judgement and confident client management. You’ll be the senior point of contact for your clients, the person the delivery team looks to for direction, and a key partner to the Head of Partnership Marketing in growing our Social Commerce offering. 

Reporting Line & Team Structure 

  • Reports into: Head of Partnership Marketing. 
  • Team leadership: Social Commerce Executives within the Partnership Marketing team, with day-to-day leadership of TikTok Shop delivery across your client accounts. 
  • Key internal relationships: Ecommerce, Customer Success, Creative, Studios, Content, Paid Social, Trading and Operations teams. 
  • Key external relationships: Client brand, ecommerce and marketing teams, TikTok platform partners, and creator and affiliate partners. 

Key Responsibilities 

TikTok Shop Strategy

  • Build and present strategic plans covering shop set-up, product and catalogue strategy, pricing and promotions, content, live shopping, creator and affiliate activity, and paid amplification. 
  • Align TikTok Shop activity with each client’s trading calendar, key retail moments and wider THG Ingenuity services to maximise commercial impact. 
  • Translate platform updates, new formats and social commerce trends into clear, actionable recommendations for clients. 

Delivery & Service Quality 

  • Take accountability for the end-to-end delivery of TikTok Shop services across your clients, ensuring work is delivered on time, on brief and to a consistently high standard. 
  • Direct and support the Social Commerce Executives and wider delivery teams day to day - prioritising workload, reviewing outputs and stepping in early where delivery starts to drift. 
  • Establish and maintain best-practice frameworks, processes and playbooks for TikTok Shop set-up, optimisation and campaign delivery. 
  • Set quality standards and QA processes across listings, content, creator activity and reporting, so every client receives the same high level of service. 
  • Coordinate effectively with creative, content, studio, paid social, ecommerce and operations teams so TikTok Shop activity is joined up and commercially aligned. 

Performance Monitoring & Optimisation 

  • Monitor TikTok Shop performance across your client portfolio, tracking GMV, conversion rate, AOV, traffic, content and creator performance, and return on spend. 
  • Own performance against agreed client KPIs and targets - identifying risks and opportunities early and leading the optimisation plan to close any gaps. 
  • Turn data into insight, delivering clear, commercially focused reporting and recommendations to clients and internal stakeholders. 
  • Use testing and learning to continuously improve shop performance, content effectiveness and creator ROI. 

Client Relationships 

  • Act as the senior day-to-day contact for your TikTok Shop clients, building trusted, long-term relationships at senior and working levels. 
  • Lead regular client meetings, performance reviews and QBRs, presenting results, insight and forward plans with confidence. 
  • Manage client expectations, feedback and escalations professionally, resolving issues quickly and protecting the relationship. 
  • Drive client satisfaction and retention, and identify opportunities to grow accounts - from expanded TikTok Shop scope into wider THG Ingenuity services - working with Customer Success and Business Development.

  • Contribute platform and client insight to THG Ingenuity’s TikTok partnership, and share knowledge across the wider business. 

What We’re Looking For

  • A track record of setting social commerce strategy and delivering measurable commercial growth (GMV, conversion, ROI).

  • Deep understanding of the TikTok Shop ecosystem, including Seller Center, affiliate and creator programmes, shoppable content, LIVE shopping and GMV Max / paid amplification. 
  • Highly data-literate, with the ability to analyse performance, draw out insight and turn it into clear actions.

title: (Senior) Software Engineer – AI (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Worum es geht

MAIA ist eine KI-Plattform für Unternehmen. Mit MAIA durchsuchen Teams ihre internen Daten und verankern Agenten tief in ihren Prozessen. Wir begleiten Unternehmen dabei, KI nicht nur in einzelnen Abteilungen, sondern im ganzen Unternehmen einzusetzen.

Technisch heißt das: Wir bauen eine GenAI-Anwendung mit eigenen Agentensystemen, RAG-Pipelines und agentenbasierten Workflows, binden externe Systeme unserer Kunden an und analysieren ihre Daten. Wir nutzen die besten verfügbaren Modelle, betrieben in der EU, und machen sie verlässlich für anspruchsvolle Arbeit mit großen, komplexen Datenmengen.

Zahlreiche Industrieunternehmen arbeiten seit Jahren intensiv mit MAIA. Nach unserer erfolgreichen Finanzierungsrunde 2026 bringen wir MAIA jetzt in die Breite. Entwickelt wird MAIA seit 2021 in Leipzig.

Was du bei uns machst

Als Software Engineer entwickelst du MAIA weiter und bestimmst von Anfang an mit, wie wir Probleme lösen.

Woran du arbeiten kannst:

  • Vom Konzept zum Feature. Gemeinsam mit dem Produktmanagement schärfst du grobe Konzepte und verantwortest Features vom Prototyp bis zur Weiterentwicklung anhand von Feedback und Nutzungsdaten.

  • Chat und Agenten. Du gestaltest, wie Menschen mit MAIA arbeiten: Fragen stellen, Kontext mitgeben und Agenten mehrstufige Aufgaben erledigen lassen – mit nachvollziehbarem Fortschritt und prüfbaren Ergebnissen.

  • Unternehmenswissen erschließen. Du bindest externe Systeme an und machst Wissen aus unterschiedlichen Dateiformaten nutzbar. So findet MAIA die richtigen Stellen, liefert Antworten mit Quellen und hält dabei bestehende Zugriffsrechte ein.

  • Modelle und Qualität. Du integrierst neue Sprachmodelle und vergleichst Qualität, Kosten und Geschwindigkeit. Mit Evals erkennst du Fehler und verbesserst Antworten und Agenten systematisch.

  • Sicher, schnell und stabil. Du baust isolierte Umgebungen für die Ausführung von Code und Tools und verbesserst Antwortzeiten und Datenverarbeitung, damit MAIA auch bei großen Wissensbeständen zuverlässig läuft.

Was wir suchen

  • Solides Software Engineering. Du hast Backend-Systeme gebaut, ausgeliefert und über längere Zeit in Produktion betrieben. Architektur, API-Design, Datenmodellierung und asynchrone Verarbeitung sind dir vertraut. Schwache Architektur erkennst du auch dann, wenn ein Coding Agent sie geschrieben hat.

  • Sehr gut in mindestens einer unserer Sprachen. TypeScript, Python oder Go, am besten eine der statisch typisierten. Alle drei musst du nicht mitbringen. In die anderen arbeitest du dich ein.

  • Zu Hause im LLM-Ökosystem. Du hast echte Anwendungen mit LLMs gebaut, beruflich oder in komplexen eigenen Projekten. RAG, Embeddings, Vektorsuche und Tool Calling kennst du aus der Praxis, auch die Stellen, an denen sie scheitern. Neue Modelle und Frameworks probierst du aus eigenem Antrieb aus und trennst dabei Substanz von Hype. Produktionserfahrung mit LLM-Systemen ist ein großes Plus.

  • Messen statt vermuten. Du weißt, wie man Systeme testet und evaluiert, die auf dieselbe Frage nicht immer gleich antworten. Du baust die einfachste Lösung, die das Problem löst. Weitere Retrieval-Stufen, Prompt-Ketten oder Abstraktionen kommen erst dazu, wenn Messungen sie rechtfertigen.

  • Produktdenken. Du denkst an die Person, die mit MAIA unter Zeitdruck ein Angebot fertigstellen oder eine technische Frage klären muss. Du steigst gern früh in die Konzepte des Produktmanagements ein, stellst die richtigen Fragen und bringst eigene Lösungsideen ein, auch wenn noch nicht alles feststeht.

  • Agentisch arbeiten. Coding Agents gehören für dich zum Alltag. Du schreibst Pläne, die andere prüfen und auf denen Coding Agents aufbauen können, prüfst die Ergebnisse kritisch und weißt, wo sie helfen und wo nicht.

  • Sicherheit mitdenken. Unsere Kunden vertrauen uns ihr internes Wissen an. Mandantentrennung, Zugriffsrechte und sichere Entwicklung sind für dich selbstverständlich.

  • Klar kommunizieren. Du erklärst technische Zusammenhänge verständlich, auch gegenüber Produktmanagement, Customer Success und Vertrieb. Du sprichst sehr sicher Deutsch und ebenso Englisch.

Die Rolle umfasst keine Personalverantwortung. Ob du als Software Engineer oder Senior Software Engineer einsteigst, besprechen wir spätestens nach dem technischen Interview offen mit dir.

Arbeiten bei MAIA

Uns verbindet ein gemeinsames Ziel: ein richtig gutes Produkt zu bauen. Jede und jeder übernimmt Verantwortung für das eigene Thema. Wir haben Spaß an der Arbeit und sind stolz auf das, was unsere Kunden mit MAIA erreichen. Die Wege sind kurz, und Entscheidungen fallen schnell. Im Engineering-Team hinterfragen wir kritisch, wie wir entwickeln, und verbessern unsere Prozesse laufend, gerade in der agentischen Entwicklung.

Wir arbeiten gern zusammen in unserem Büro, zentral zwischen Innenstadt und Zoo, und kochen fast jeden Tag gemeinsam. An mindestens drei Tagen pro Woche sind wir vor Ort, an den übrigen arbeitest du, wo du möchtest. Wann dein Tag beginnt, legst du selbst fest.

  • Zugang zu aktuellen Frontier-Modellen und Coding Agents

  • Unterstützung bei Weiterbildungen, die zu deiner beruflichen Entwicklung passen

  • Zugang zu einer Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft

Vergütung

Das Jahresbruttogehalt liegt bei 75.000 bis 95.000 €. Wo du in dieser Spanne liegst, hängt von deinem Level ab. Darüber sprechen wir spätestens nach dem technischen Interview. Dazu kommt eine virtuelle Beteiligung über unser VSOP.

Bewerbung und nächste Schritte

Ein Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und beantworte uns in ein paar eigenen Sätzen eine Frage: Warum willst du MAIA mitgestalten?

Wir arbeiten jeden Tag mit KI. Für diese Antwort zählt aber deine eigene Perspektive. Schreib sie deshalb bitte selbst, gern kurz und ohne Feinschliff.

Passt es, folgen ein 30-minütiges Kennenlernen, ein 90-minütiges technisches Interview und ein Abschlussgespräch mit der Geschäftsführung. Nach jedem Schritt hörst du in der Regel innerhalb von zwei Werktagen von uns. Unser Ziel ist eine Entscheidung in rund drei Wochen.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung.

Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Role:

As a Senior Solutions Architect specializing in containerized solutions, you will play a crucial, pioneering role in this new initiative. Your primary focus will be leading the deployment of these solutions within our customer environments.

title: Senior Solutions Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Join Choco, where we build and own solutions that reshape a broken food system.

The global food supply chain is inefficient by design. Waste is high, margins are thin, and most distributor order processes are done over the phone, tracked across broad spreadsheets, and based on intuition rather than strong data.


At Choco, we’re changing that. We build software used daily by food distributors and their customers to run their business. It automates orders, reduces errors, and helps operations run faster and more reliably. Because it’s embedded in daily operations, our SaaS platform has immediate, real-world impact, on efficiency, margins, and how businesses run day to day.

Mission

As a Senior Solutions Engineer, you will deliver fast, reliable, API-driven integrations for our largest customers by translating business workflows into scalable, repeatable technical solutions. You will partner closely with Sales and Customer Success to deliver best-in-class integration experiences that drive adoption and long-term success. This role is primarily customer-facing, with a strong focus on solution design and customer outcomes rather than traditional software development. You'll build integrations primarily with low-code tools, using light scripting where needed.

What You’ll Do

  • Independently design, build, and deliver complex, scalable, and secure integrations between Choco and customer systems using low-code tools (e.g. n8n and Tray.ai).

  • Own complex and strategic integration projects end-to-end, from technical discovery and solution architecture to go-live, ensuring quality, scalability, and long-term reliability.

  • Partner with Account Executives in pre-sales by leading technical discovery, proofs of concept, and integration scoping, advising on feasibility and solution design for complex customer requirements.

  • Act as a technical escalation point, troubleshooting critical integration issues, proactively identifying risks, and driving sustainable solutions.

  • Collaborate closely with Customer Success, Implementation, and Product teams, providing technical guidance, documenting integration designs, and influencing product improvements based on customer needs.

  • Mentor junior Solutions Engineers, providing technical guidance, sharing expertise, and supporting their development through complex projects.

  • Drive continuous improvement of integration architecture, processes, and best practices to increase delivery efficiency, quality, and scalability globally.

  • Independently make technical and architectural decisions within complex projects, escalating only major strategic decisions requiring broader alignment.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of experience in solutions engineering, IT/ERP consulting, or systems integration.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Experience managing end-to-end API integrations, including requirements gathering, solution design, implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing support across multiple customer environments.

  • Experience with low-code or automation tools such as n8n, Zapier, and Tray.ai.

  • Basic programming knowledge (e.g. JavaScript or Python) and working knowledge of REST APIs, JSON/XML, webhooks, authentication (OAuth, API keys), and data mapping.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a collaborative, solution-focused mindset.

  • Excellent communicator with the ability to make complex ideas clear and simple.

  • This position requires in-office attendance 3 days per week in our Paris office.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with the ERP or ordering systems common among food and beverage distributors.

  • Background in food distribution, supply chain, or B2B SaaS.

  • Familiarity with EDI, SFTP/flat-file integrations, or basic SQL.

  • Comfort using AI tools to speed up discovery, documentation, and integration builds.

What you get

  • Work on digitalizing core operating systems for food distributors, automating orders, sales and payments in a system that still largely runs on calls and spreadsheets.

  • Work with an AI product with proven product–market fit, already embedded in distributor workflows and directly affecting order accuracy, speed, and margins.

  • Join a global team across 6 countries and 40+ nationalities, building a company that has raised $300M+ and reached unicorn status (~$1.2B valuation) with the ambition to define this category end-to-end.

  • In return, you get real ownership, equity, and the support to do your best work, including competitive compensation, health and wellbeing support, and long-term benefits like a sabbatical (all localized by office).

  • Collaborate with people who want to own outcomes in a messy, real-world system and make it work at scale.

If you want to work on real problems, take ownership, and raise the bar, we should talk.

All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Senior Talent Acquisition Partner (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Bei Superchat gestalten wir neu, wie Unternehmen mit ihren Kund:innen kommunizieren. KI wird dabei immer mehr zum Motor dieser Kommunikation. Integrationen sind das, was diesem Motor echte Power gibt: die Daten, Tools und Systeme, die aus einem cleveren AI-Agenten einen machen, der Prozesse wirklich automatisiert und Probleme löst.

Gegründet im Jahr 2020, ist Superchat heute die Plattform für über 10.000 Unternehmen weltweit - von bekannten Marken wie Allianz, Auto1, Enpal, Danone und GASAG bis hin zu kleinen Unternehmen, Zahnarztpraxen und Solo-Founder:innen, die professioneller auftreten möchten.

Inzwischen laufen täglich Millionen von Nachrichten über Superchat.

Gestartet sind wir als Unified Inbox – ein zentraler Ort für alle Kommunikationskanäle wie WhatsApp, E-Mail, SMS oder Instagram. Mit dem Aufstieg von ChatGPT begann unser nächstes Kapitel: AI Agents, die über Chat, E-Mail und Voice in einer Qualität kommunizieren, die mit den besten menschlichen Teams mithalten kann.

Heute sind wir ein Team von rund 100 Mitarbeitenden, arbeiten profitabel und haben insgesamt 18 Millionen Euro Funding eingesammelt (unsere letzte Finanzierungsrunde liegt bereits 4,5 Jahre zurück – seitdem wachsen wir aus eigener Kraft weiter).

Unser Hauptsitz ist in Berlin.

In dieser Rolle gestaltest du aktiv, wie Superchat wächst. Du verantwortest den gesamten Recruiting-Prozess für zentrale Rollen, arbeitest eng mit Hiring Managern und dem Leadership-Team zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass wir die richtigen Menschen für unser nächstes Wachstumskapitel gewinnen. Wenn du Lust hast, Recruiting strategisch mitzugestalten und gleichzeitig hands-on zu arbeiten, könnte das perfekt zu dir passen.

Who We Want

Experienced and growth-oriented.

Du bringst 3+ Jahre Erfahrung im Recruiting mit und hast gleichzeitig die Motivation, weiter zu lernen, Prozesse aktiv mitzugestalten und gemeinsam mit dem Team zu wachsen.

Startup-minded and fast-paced.

Du fühlst dich in dynamischen Umfeldern wohl, priorisierst smart und behältst auch bei vielen offenen Rollen und wechselnden Anforderungen den Überblick. Idealerweise bringst du Erfahrung aus dem SaaS- oder Tech-Umfeld mit.

Recruiting-first mindset.

Du denkst Recruiting nicht nur operativ, sondern strategisch mit. Du bringst eigene Ideen ein, hinterfragst bestehende Prozesse und hilfst dabei, unser Talent Acquisition Setup auf das nächste Level zu bringen.

Strong communicator.

Du kommunizierst sicher und professionell auf Deutsch und Englisch – egal ob im Austausch mit Kandidat:innen, Hiring Managern oder im Stakeholder-Management. Klar, empathisch und überzeugend.

Owns processes, not just tasks.

Du übernimmst Verantwortung für den gesamten Recruiting-Prozess – von der ersten Ansprache bis zum Offer – und sorgst dafür, dass Kandidat:innen eine starke Experience haben.

Flexible and calm under pressure.

Du bleibst hands-on, lösungsorientiert und organisiert, auch wenn es schnell geht oder Prioritäten sich kurzfristig ändern.

Who We Don’t Want

  • Menschen mit einer “Das ist nicht mein Job”-Mentalität. Ob kurzfristiges Active Sourcing, ein spontaner Hiring Sync oder Unterstützung bei Employer Branding
  • Kandidat:innen-Erfahrung ist für uns kein “Bonus”. Wir suchen keine Recruiter:innen, die unstrukturierte Prozesse, langsame Kommunikation oder Ghosting als normal ansehen
  • Personen, die bei vielen offenen Rollen oder wechselnden Prioritäten schnell den Überblick verlieren. Startup bedeutet Dynamik und wir brauchen Menschen die darin aufblühen
  • Recruiter:innen, die Recruiting nur als “Rollen besetzen” sehen. Für uns geht es darum, langfristig starke Teams aufzubauen und das Wachstum der Company aktiv mitzugestalten
  • Menschen, die sich ausschließlich auf eingehende Bewerbungen verlassen. aktives Sourcing und starke Pipelines aufzubauen gehört bei uns zum Daily Business.

Your Day To Day

Talent Acquisition & Pipeline Aufbau (ca. 60%)

  • Du arbeitest eng mit Hiring Managern und unserem Leadership-Team zusammen, um Top-Talente in Bereichen wie Product, Sales, Marketing, Operations, Finance und Engineering zu gewinnen
  • Du entwickelst kreative Sourcing-Strategien und baust dir über LinkedIn & Co. starke Talent-Pipelines für unsere zukünftigen Teams auf
  • Du identifizierst spannende Kandidat:innen proaktiv und begeisterst sie für unsere Vision, unser Wachstum und die Möglichkeiten bei uns
  • Du führst Rollenbriefings mit den Fachbereichen durch, stellst die richtigen Fragen und sorgst dafür, dass alle ein gemeinsames Verständnis des perfekten Kandidatenprofils haben

Process Improvement & Recruiting Operations (ca. 40%)

  • Du denkst Recruiting-Prozesse kontinuierlich weiter, erkennst Reibungspunkte in der Candidate Journey und setzt neue Ideen sowie Experimente zur Optimierung um
  • Du bringst eigene Ideen ein, challengst bestehende Prozesse und hilfst dabei, unsere Recruiting-Strukturen skalierbar und zukunftsfähig aufzubauen

Stakeholders

Kandidat:innen: täglich, wichtigste Ansprechperson während des gesamten Recruiting-Prozesses
People Team: täglich für Check-ins, Prozessoptimierung, Knowledge Sharing und die Weiterentwicklung unserer Recruiting-Strukturen
Hiring Manager: regelmäßig für Rollenbriefings, Profilabstimmungen, Interview-Debriefs und Hiring-Entscheidungen
C-Level & Leadership Team: für strategische Hiring-Themen, Teamstrukturen, Priorisierung und finale Entscheidungen

Why People Choose Us

  • Wir glauben an Zusammenarbeit vor Ort: Du arbeitest mindestens drei Tage pro Woche mit dem Team aus unserem Berliner Office. Viele der besten Ideen entstehen gemeinsam im selben Raum - Entscheidungen werden schneller getroffen, wir lernen voneinander und wachsen als Team enger zusammen
  • Wir sind ein internationales Team mit unterschiedlichsten kulturellen Hintergründen und Sprachen - Offenheit, gegenseitiger Respekt und der Austausch verschiedener Perspektiven prägen unsere Zusammenarbeit
  • Wir schätzen Ambition und Motivation - wir suchen Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, Initiative zeigen und Lust haben, sich schnell weiterzuentwickeln
  • Wir arbeiten mit hoher Eigenverantwortung und einer starken Lernmentalität - Fragen stellen, neugierig bleiben und sich kontinuierlich verbessern gehört bei uns dazu
  • Wir legen Wert auf Humbleness und Teamgeist - no Ego, offenes Feedback und die Bereitschaft voneinander zu lernen sind uns wichtiger als Titel

Benefits & culture

  • Du hast die Wahl zwischen einer Urban Sports Club/John Reed Mitgliedschaft oder Fahrkarten/Dance-Abo
  • Regelmäßige Firmen- und Teamevents
  • Jährliches Budget für persönliche Weiterbildung in Höhe von 500 € für zum Beispiel Konferenzen, Kurse, Bücher, Karrierecoach usw.
  • Eine integrative und aufregende Start-up-Kultur, die schnelles berufliches und persönliches Wachstum ermöglicht
  • Schönes Büro im Herzen von Berlin (Prenzlauer Allee 242) mit kostenlosen Snacks, Getränken und bester Ausstattung

We want to build a community, not just a company.

Uns ist wichtig, ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem Menschen wirklich gerne Zeit miteinander verbringen - egal ob beim HYROX-Training, Golfen, Beer-Pong-Turnieren, Running Clubs, Warhammer, gemeinsamen Wochenendaktivitäten oder welcher Community auch immer du hier aufbauen möchtest!

title: Senior TechOps Engineer Contract
descriptionHtml:
Working at CreateFutureCreateFuture is an AI-native consulting partner where people do work that matters and are supported to do it well. We work alongside organisations such as PayPal, adidas, NatWest, FanDuel and Money Saving Expert, building digital products and services that make a difference  while always putting people first.

We’re a team of creators. We write code, shape delivery, build go-to-market strategies, develop AI solutions and create the practices that support our people. We work side by side with our clients, challenging what’s not working and helping them to build the future. Our commitment to craft, quality, and culture has helped us scale to over 600 people in just a few years.

CreateFuture is a Great Place to Work-Certified™ company and has won Best Workplaces UK multiple years in a row.

Join us on our journey. Let’s create tomorrow, together, today.

About the role and team:

We are looking for TechOps Engineers to operate, stabilise and modernise our Azure-hosted platforms (Java/Spring Boot microservices on RHEL). The role covers 24/7 operations, incident management, hands-on troubleshooting and security remediation, and helps build out a codified platform: Terraform, GitHub Actions + Ansible, and centralised ELK.

Key responsibilities

  • Build and support environments on Azure; hands-on RHEL administration (hardening, patching, tuning)
  • Act as escalation for L2/L3 incidents, driving RCA and permanent fixes
  • Debug issues hands-on across the stack (OS, network, middleware, JVM, database) using logs, metrics, thread/heap dumps and packet captures
  • Support Java/Spring Boot microservices and the middleware they run on; diagnose JVM issues (memory, GC, threads, latency)
  • Drive security vulnerability remediation across OS, middleware and cloud platform
  • Collaborate with Security/SOC/NOC on incident response and post-incident reviews
  • Deliver changes as code: infrastructure in Terraform, deployments via GitHub Actions running Ansible
  • Own backup, restore testing and DR failover readiness
  • Participate in regular 24/7 on-call rotation
  • Manage incidents/problems/changes via Jira Service Management
  • Maintain runbooks, dashboards and documentation
  • Work with development and Platform team to take ownership of an inherited Azure estate, stabilise it, then modernise it with AI-assisted & reviewed tooling

Technical skills

  • Cloud/Network: Azure VMs, VNet, NSG, Load Balancer, App Gateway/WAF, Firewall, Virtual WAN, Key Vault, private endpoints, VPN; Azure Front Door, Cloudflare, Nginx, TLS
  • Data: Azure MySQL Flexible Server (HA, replicas, point-in-time restore), Redis, Blob Storage; Canal (MySQL CDC), MongoDB
  • OS: RHEL (enterprise production), Azure Update Manager; Docker engine on hosts
  • Java/Middleware: Spring Boot, Dubbo, Nacos, ZooKeeper, XXL-Job, Kafka, RabbitMQ
  • Observability: Elastic Stack (Elasticsearch cluster ops, ILM, Logstash, Kibana); Prometheus, Alertmanager, Grafana, Azure Monitor; Micrometer/JVM observability; PagerDuty
  • Access/Security: Entra ID, RBAC, PIM; Azure Bastion, JumpServer (PAM), Zscaler ZPA
  • Backup/DR: Azure Backup, DR region failover
  • IaC/CI/CD: Terraform, GitHub Actions, Ansible, GitHub Packages, GitOps; Python, Bash
  • Tooling: Jira Service Management, Confluenc

Requirements

  • 8+ years in TechOps/Infrastructure/SRE/Production Operations
  • Strong hands-on Azure and RHEL experience in production
  • Proven support of Java microservices/middleware in production
  • Strong hands-on debugging and analytical skills; comfortable working an unfamiliar problem from symptoms to root cause
  • Advanced Elasticsearch and JVM observability skills
  • Hands-on Terraform, GitHub Actions and Ansible; Python/Bash scripting
  • Strong incident management/RCA capability; ITIL familiarity
  • Comfortable with 24/7 operations; strong communication
  • Experience in gaming or another regulated, high-availability digital sector
  • Systems administration experience desired

We trust people to do their best work. That means flexibility over rigid rules, impact over activity, and real investment in your growth both professionally and personally. You’ll be part of a supportive, and friendly culture, surrounded by smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do.

We offer flexible working, including hybrid and remote options. Our office hubs are located in Edinburgh, Leeds, Manchester, London and Bulgaria, with occasional travel to client sites or CreateFuture offices when needed.

We trust you to manage your time balancing collaboration with client time and focused work. What matters is the impact you have, not how busy you look.

Depending on the role, we might also ask you to do a short presentation, a practical or technical task or have a values focused conversation. We will explain what is involved before anything happens.

Inclusion at CreateFuture 

We believe diverse teams build better workplaces and better products. We want CreateFuture to be a place where people feel able to be themselves and do their best work.

If you need any adjustments or support during the application process, just. We will do what we can to help.

title: Senior  Veterinary Surgeon - Emergency Out of Hours
descriptionHtml:
Vets Now Chesterfield are welcoming applications from Out of Hours (OOH) Veterinary Surgeons with a passion for Emergency & Critical Care to lead their team on a full-time basis. Vets Now is the UK’s leading provider of emergency veterinary care, with a nationwide network of out of hours clinics and 24/7 emergency hospitals. As part of Inspiring Vet Care, our teams make a difference to pets and their owners when they need us most.

At Vets Now, we believe that when your purpose is to make a difference, you deserve a team that shares your passion. We want to find someone who can lead from the front, inspiring clinical excellence and guiding a high-performing and collaborative team that supports pets and people when they need it most. In return, we can offer a £10,000 recognition bonus (pro-rata) and up to £5000 relocation allowance for the right candidate.

Chesterfield is a vibrant, family-friendly market town that offers an affordable lifestyle right on the edge of the Peak District National Park. Ranked as one of the most affordable market towns in England for people stepping onto the property ladder, Chesterfield is centrally located for road and rail access across the UK.

Lead with Clinical Excellence

As Senior Vet, you’ll lead by example by blending clinical expertise with mentorship and collaboration. You’ll set the tone for quality care, lead in emergency situations, and support the development of your fellow clinicians. You'll have responsibility for:

* Driving and upholding clinical standards across the clinic * Supporting the growth, training and wellbeing of your veterinary team * Identifying clinical development opportunities and shaping team progression * Championing innovation and service improvement within the clinic * This is more than a job. This is a vital leadership role with real impact where your guidance helps shape the future of ECC, while making a difference to patients, clients, and colleagues every day.

Work-Life Balance That Works for You

This full-time role averages 40 hours per week, including:

* Nightshifts 1830-0900, Saturday dayshift 1200-1930 and Sunday dayshift 0830-1930 * 1:2 weekends (mix of nights and days) * No more than three consecutive nights * Shared bank holidays * Protected time for leadership duties and meetings

We understand that life outside of work matters too. That’s why we offer flexibility and can explore part-time arrangements, depending on clinic requirements because your balance is our priority.

Rewarding Work, Your Way

We look after you, so you can look after them, by offering a highly competitive salary and a comprehensive benefits package, including:

* Seven weeks’ pro rata annual leave * £1,875 CPD allowance + 35 paid CPD hours (pro rata) * RCVS fees, VECCS membership, and VDS cover * Private medical insurance * Family-friendly policies - enhanced maternity, paternity & adoption pay * Leadership Development Programme * Access to our AdvantEdge clinical training platform * Standard pension contributions (5% employee / 3% employer) * Up to 50% discounted pet care

Collaborative Spirit

You’re never alone at Vets Now: on-shift you’ll work alongside a registered vet nurse, an animal care assistant and a receptionist, and you can contact any of our clinics or referral centers across the UK at anytime, day or night, if needing to discuss a particular case or share ideas.

title: Software Engineer, Agent (New Grad 2027)
descriptionHtml:
About us

Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Our co-founders are Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor. Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.

What you’ll do

  • Design and deliver production-grade AI agents: You'll build and ship highly performant, reliable, and intuitive AI agents that are central, mission-critical and drive revenue directly to Sierra's growth. These aren't prototypes—they are powerful, scalable systems running in production environments across industries like finance, healthcare, and commerce.

  • Drive the Agent Development Life Cycle (ADLC): You'll have complete ownership and autonomy from initial pilot through deployment and continuous iteration. You'll be responsible for building, tuning, and evolving AI agents in production environments, defining the standard for ADLC best practices along the way.

  • Partner with large enterprises and cutting-edge startups: You’ll work directly with leaders at some of the world’s largest enterprises to understand their most pressing business challenges, and build AI agents that transform how they operate at scale. You'll also partner with the most cutting-edge startups in Silicon Valley, embedding AI agents across their entire business stack to drive innovation and efficiency.

  • Build the future of the platform: Your direct work with customers will guide the evolution of Sierra's core platform. You'll surface unmet needs, prototype new tools and features, and collaborate with research, product, and platform to shape the future of AI agent development and Sierra's product.

Example projects

These are some examples of projects that engineers on our team have worked on recently:

  • Design and build AI agents for large telecommunications and media companies that consistently outperform human agents in managing subscription churn

  • Develop and refine AI agents capable of navigating complex customer interactions, like troubleshooting a broken device and personalizing product recommendations

  • Create generalizable AI agent frameworks tailored for industry-specific use cases. See some examples in our financial services blog!

  • Facilitate design partnerships for new product initiatives, such as new agent architectures, self-service capabilities, and generative agent development

  • Experiment with the latest voice models and figure out how to integrate them at scale to enterprise-grade customers

What you'll bring

  • Experience building and scaling end-to-end production systems

  • Strong technical problem-solving skills, especially in fast-changing, ambiguous environments

  • A builder and tinkerer’s mindset with high agency - you find creative ways to overcome obstacles and ship

  • Comfort working directly with customers to understand their needs and solve real-world problems

  • Excellent communication skills - clear, direct, and persuasive across technical and non-technical audiences

Even better...

  • Experience building or deploying AI/LLM systems in production

  • Have been a founder or founding engineer - you know what it means to balance craft, ownership, and speed

  • Familiarity with tools that power today's AI agents: eval frameworks, agent tooling, RAG pipelines, and prompt engineering

  • Prior experience with React, TypeScript, and/or Go

  • Previous roles where you interfaced with customers or led technical projects with external stakeholders

Our values

  • Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work.

  • Customer Obsession: We deeply understand our customers’ business goals and relentlessly focus on driving outcomes, not just technical milestones. Everyone at the company knows and spends time with our customers. When our customer is having an issue, we drop everything and fix it.

  • Craftsmanship: We get the details right, from the words on the page to the system architecture. We have good taste. When we notice something isn’t right, we take the time to fix it. We are proud of the products we produce. We continuously self-reflect to continuously self-improve.

  • Intensity: We know we don’t have the luxury of patience. We play to win. We care about our product being the best, and when it isn’t, we fix it. When we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.

  • Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We are the best technology company for parents. We support and respect each other and celebrate each other’s personal and professional achievements.

What we offer

We want our benefits to reflect our values and offer the following to full-time employees:

  • Flexible (unlimited) paid time off

  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family

  • Life insurance and disability benefits

  • Retirement plan dependent on country of employment

  • Parental leave

  • Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot

  • Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized 

  • Discretionary benefit stipend giving people the ability to spend where it matters most

  • Free alphorn lessons

These benefits are further detailed in Sierra's policies, may vary by region, and are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefits plans. Eligible full-time employees can participate in Sierra's equity plans subject to the terms of the applicable plans and policies.

Be you, with us

We're working to bring the transformative power of AI to every organization in the world. To do so, it is important to us that the diversity of our employees represents the diversity of our customers. We believe that our work and culture are better when we encourage, support, and respect different skills and experiences represented within our team. title: Software Engineer, Agentic AI
descriptionHtml:
Teamwork makes the stream work.

Roku is changing how the world watches TV

Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.

From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.

What does the team work on?

Roku TV is where embedded systems, media experiences, and intelligent software come together at massive scale. The Roku TV organization builds technology used on millions of TVs globally, and the team is already applying AI to demanding TV problems in resource-constrained environments where quality, performance, and reliability matter.
As part of this team, you will help define how agentic AI systems are designed, built, and operated for Roku TV use cases. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who treats AI agent design as an engineering discipline: architecting durable systems, grounding them in the right context, integrating them with tools and services, and making them reliable in production.

What is the role?

We are looking for a hands-on, systems-oriented Agentic AI Engineer of roughl7 2-5yrs experience to design, build, and maintain intelligent agents and copilots that drive automation, accelerate workflows, and unlock new product and platform capabilities for Roku TV. You will own the full lifecycle of agent development—from prototyping and architecture through orchestration, evaluation, deployment, observability, and continuous improvement.
You will contribute directly to Roku’s AI strategy by engineering reusable components, optimizing agent workflows, and ensuring strong real-world performance in production environments.

How will I use AI at Roku? 

At Roku, we don’t just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability. We’re looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they’ve used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact. 

 
We value your AI skills if have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain — coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks. And you can describe projects where you shipped real work with these tools. You know how to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you. 

What are the responsibilities of the role?

  • Architect, develop, and deploy AI agents and copilots for Roku TV use cases, integrating them with internal systems, tools, and services.
  • Own end-to-end agentic systems from concept to production, including model selection, prompt and context design, retrieval strategies, backend services, and conversational interfaces.
  • Design and implement single-agent and multi-agent orchestration patterns, including handoffs, delegation, and cooperative task execution.
  • Build scalable RAG and context pipelines that provide high-quality grounding for AI systems and keep them aligned with evolving data sources and business logic.
  • Implement tool-calling, function-calling, and MCP-style integrations so agents can safely take actions and interact with the systems around them.
  • Create reusable agent templates, modular components, and paved-path patterns that accelerate adoption across teams and use cases.
  • Establish strong evaluation, observability, and monitoring for conversation quality, task success rate, latency, cost, and overall system performance.
  • Build safeguards that improve production readiness and reliability, including testing pipelines, controlled rollouts, drift detection, and mechanisms that prevent error amplification in multi-step workflows.
  • Prototype quickly, run experiments, and translate successful ideas into durable, scalable software solutions.
  • Partner closely with engineering, product, QA, infrastructure, and cross-functional teams to deliver meaningful business and customer outcomes.

What experience would help someone be successful in the role at Roku? 

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field.
  • 2-5 years of experience in software engineering, AI/ML engineering, backend development, or adjacent domains, with strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to build production-grade systems.
  • Strong proficiency in Python, plus experience with C/C++ or another systems language.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM-based systems, including prompt design, retrieval, tool use, memory handling, and agent orchestration patterns.
  • Experience building and maintaining RAG pipelines, agent frameworks, MCP servers or equivalent function-calling architectures, and conversational interfaces.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms, REST APIs, containerization, and modern deployment environments.
  • Experience with observability, evaluation, experimentation, and feedback loops for AI systems in production.
  • Ability to work independently, manage ambiguity, move quickly, and deliver incrementally in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent communication skills, sound engineering judgment, and a collaborative working style.

Nice to have

  • Experience with multi-agent frameworks or orchestration systems such as LangChain, AutoGen, or Semantic Kernel.
  • Experience with video, audio, TV, or edge-device environments, especially where latency, cost, and hardware constraints matter.
  • Familiarity with ML/DL frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.
  • Research experience, paper implementation experience, or a habit of applying emerging GenAI techniques pragmatically to real problems.
#LI-NM1

What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?

Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.

What are some of the benefits?

Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.

Accommodations

Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to  

What should I know about Roku's culture?

Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV. 

We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002. 

To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet.

title: Software Engineer - Database
descriptionHtml:
About MotherDuck

Don’t let the quirky name fool you: At MotherDuck, we’re on a mission to make data warehousing fun, frictionless, and ducking awesome for developers and data practitioners building blazing fast internal and customer-facing analytics experiences. We're building a cloud-hosted version of DuckDB, working hand-in-hand with the creators of the fastest-growing and fastest-improving query engine on the planet. Unlike other databases, MotherDuck was architected to unify local development with cloud operations to bridge the gap between software and data engineering workflows. Our team is a mix of thoughtful, passionate, and empathetic data industry veterans.

What you will do

The Database team is the bridge between DuckDB and the cloud. We own the core server and client extension logic that lets DuckDB run seamlessly, whether it's local or in the cloud, and we work in C++ right alongside the DuckDB codebase itself. Our mission is to push the boundaries of embedded database performance, distributed execution, and user experience, all while staying closely connected to DuckDB Labs (the team behind DuckDB) to align on APIs and shape what's next.

Day to day, we drive major projects in dual execution, resource assignment, and system reliability, while also handling incoming issues and lending our DuckDB expertise to other teams. We collaborate closely across MotherDuck and with the wider DuckDB community, making sure people get the best of both local and cloud worlds. It's a small, high-agency team with big ambitions... the kind of place where engineers own impactful projects, share what they learn, and help shape how modern analytics gets built.

This role is ideally based in Amsterdam or Berlin, but we are also open to great candidates remotely in Europe.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own major projects in our dual execution stack, so DuckDB can process queries seamlessly whether they're running locally or in the cloud.

  • Help build a cloud platform that dynamically assigns resources, so DuckDB stays efficient whether someone's running a tiny workload or pushing our biggest, highest-memory instances.

  • Lead cross-functional work with our frontend, platform, and infrastructure teams to keep the user experience coherent end to end.

  • Push the state of the art in embedded database performance, distributed execution, and DuckDB internals.

  • Deepen your DuckDB expertise and share it with the rest of the company through mentorship and documentation.

  • Work directly with our support team to debug issues, learn from real usage patterns, and prioritize the improvements that matter most.

  • Improve systems holistically... spotting architectural challenges early and clearing bottlenecks before they become problems.

  • Mentor teammates and help raise the bar for engineering practices across the team.

  • Work closely with DuckDB Labs (which grew out of the Database Architectures group at CWI, where vectorized execution and DuckDB were born) to help align on APIs and shape where DuckDB goes next.

What you bring

  • You've built and shipped complex backend systems, and you know what great looks like.

  • You're fluent in a backend language like C++, Rust, Java, or similar systems languages, and you're comfortable working close to the metal. (C++ and Rust are the biggest plus here, and we love a great Java engineer too.)

  • A good foundation in query engines, execution plans, indexing, and performance optimization techniques.

  • Hands-on experience with DuckDB is a huge plus, no matter what level you're coming in at.

  • You've worked with cloud infrastructure, networking, and building low-latency distributed systems.

  • You can scope and lead projects that span multiple collaborators and cross-functional dependencies.

  • You take pride in clear thinking, careful design, and thoughtful tradeoffs.

  • You're comfortable mentoring peers and helping build a collaborative, high-agency environment.

  • You enjoy engaging with the wider community, whether that's open-source conversations or working directly with DuckDB Labs.

What we provide

  • The opportunity to participate and contribute to DuckDB, one of most popular modern open source analytical databases.

  • Competitive salary and stock options so you have a stake in our flock’s success.

  • Flexible time off – take the time you need to recharge, explore, or just have a lazy day by the pond.

  • A good pension plan

  • Legendary company events – we bring the whole flock together once a year for unforgettable team gatherings a year to keep our bonds strong.

  • Hybrid work environment – Spend three days a week in the office collaborating with the flock, and work from wherever you’re most productive the rest of the time—whether that’s your home office, a coffee shop, or a peaceful lakeside retreat. We have to warn you though, most of us like the office so much we come anyway. It’s on the river Ij, with a great lunch every day.

Research has shown that underrepresented groups in technology often shy away from roles which aren’t a 100% match. title: Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About us

People assume the supply chain is an automated, algorithmic system. It is not. It is a large number of people acting as the glue between organisations and systems, doing work the world depends on with tools that have barely changed in decades. Nexcade builds AI agents for those people, starting in freight forwarding, a $210BN industry.

Our agents are live in production with some of the leading global forwarders, pricing millions in freight every week, and we are expanding the platform deeper into the shipment lifecycle. We have raised $8.5M to make this a reality.

Our founders, Dan and Tasho, spent years at Sedna and Palantir working with supply chain companies on problems like this one. We are backed by top VCs and angels who backed or founded Synthesia, n8n and other world-class companies.

How we work

  • Everybody codes, founders included. The whole company is technical, commercial team included, and runs on coding agents.

  • Closely with customers and design partners, so what we ship changes how they operate.

  • At pace. Fast cycles and quick iterations, on the product and on how we work.

  • End to end. If you see something broken or missing, you have the freedom (and the responsibility) to fix it.

  • In person, 4+ days a week in London. We value synchronous communication.

  • Debate rigorously, decide quickly, execute relentlessly.

  • Enjoy the journey. Hard problems, good colleagues.

The role

We are building the AI platform for freight forwarding and expanding our product surface, and we are hiring software engineers across product, AI and platform to do it.

You will build products that do freight forwarding work alongside our customers' teams, operating across the entire shipment lifecycle. You will work across the stack in Python, TypeScript and React, and directly with customers and founders on what gets built.

Everyone here works across the stack, but each engineer has a spike: the area where they set the bar for the team. You spend most of your time where yours is, and lean on your colleagues where theirs are.

  • Product: You build best in class products for the core jobs in freight forwarding, one job at a time. You work as a design partner with our customers to understand the work deeply, turn that understanding into a product they would choose over anything else, and feed what you learn back into the platform everyone builds on.

  • AI: You raise the ceiling on what our AI can do and the floor on how reliably it does it. That spans high volume tasks like classification and extraction and deep workflow tasks that run for hours. You design for performance, reliability, explainability and control, set up the gyms and evals to measure them, and build the harness that runs our agents in all of our products.

  • Platform: You own the foundation every product stands on: the runtime for thousands of concurrent agents and workflows, the way they communicate and scale, the controls for how they access data with permissions that hold, and the observability to see and measure all of it. You ensure the rest of the team can move fast without fear.

What we look for

  • A spike, with evidence. Something you have been exceptional at and proof of it. We hire on slope rather than years, so there is no experience threshold in either direction.

  • Strong fundamentals. In the AI-assisted era, having good technical judgement is key. You have shipped production systems people depend on, seen them fail and learned from it.

  • High agency and ownership. You take an ambiguous problem, make a call, and see it through.

  • Humility and learning velocity. You want to get better and you change your mind when the evidence says so.

  • Interest in the problem. You do not need a freight background, but you need to find messy real-world operations interesting rather than a chore.

Why join

You will shape the product, the architecture and the company, working alongside an engineering team from Palantir, Raft, Faculty, UnlikelyAI and Oxford. You will work directly with the businesses using what you build, on AI applied to an industry that has resisted software for decades. You will get meaningful equity, so when this works you share in it.

title: Solution Architect Microsoft Dynamics
descriptionHtml:
Rol introductie

Jij hebt het! Dat waar wij niet zonder kunnen en onze klanten beter van worden. Jij bent in staat om in wisselende projectteams het beste uit elk team te halen en onmogelijke problemen om te zetten in mogelijkheden.


Als Solution Architect ben je functioneel verantwoordelijk voor een optimale implementatie van de integrale Dynamics 365 oplossing. Je bent het inhoudelijke geweten van de Project Manager en sparringpartner voor het management van onze klant. De best practices die wij en Microsoft hebben opgebouwd laat je hierbij leidend zijn. Op basis hiervan ben je voorstellend en adviserend naar je klanten. Daarnaast weet je de bedachte applicatie landschap ook overtuigend te presenteren aan de klant.

Wat ga je doen?

Je stelt de roadmap op om de integrale oplossing te implementeren. Je kunt denken vanuit integrale processen waarbij meerdere Microsoft oplossingen betrokken zijn:

  • Vaak ben je ook betrokken en ook verantwoordelijk voor de realisatie /implementatie van de oplossing;
  • Daarnaast geef je input voor de doorontwikkeling van branche oplossingen van HSO;
  • Je signaleert proactief optimalisatiemogelijkheden en adviseer je klanten over nieuwe functies en diensten binnen het Microsoft-ecosysteem die hun bedrijfsresultaten verbeteren;
  • Vaak ben je ook betrokken en ook verantwoordelijk voor de realisatie /implementatie van de oplossing;
  • Je bent de spin in het web tussen klant, je technische en functionele collega’s en de project managers.

Over het team

Je bent onderdeel van de Service Line Unified Operations, een onderdeel van HSO Nederland. Unified Operations is een geoliede projectservices organisatie met een uitstekende reputatie op het gebied van ERP. Samen met de andere Servicelines binnen HSO kunnen we de complete Microsoft Stack aanbieden (Modern Workplace, Analytics, CE, Azure Integrations,  e.d.). Het totale team van onze Service Line bestaat momenteel uit ruim 80 professionals, onder leiding van de Service Line Director Roy Daniels.

Kwalificaties

  • Je hebt een HBO of WO werk- en denkniveau (bij voorkeur afgestudeerd) in bedrijfskunde, informatica, engineering (Industrial of logistics), supply chain management of een vergelijkbare opleiding;
  • Je hebt minimaal 2 jaar ervaring met het ontwerpen van applicatie landschappen over verschillende functionele domeinen;
  • Je hebt liefst affiniteit en ervaring met het inhoudelijk aansturen van een team AX/D365 professionals;
  • Je hebt minimaal 6 jaar implementatie en consultancy ervaring met Microsoft Dynamics AX tot aan de laatste D365 versie;
  • Jarenlange ervaring opgedaan in 1 of 2 van de branches Retail, Distribution, Project/Services of Manufacturing. Mede op basis hiervan kun jij klanten overtuigen van onze adviezen en voorstellen. Methodologische affiniteit. Zowel op het gebied van het architectuur (TOGAF kennis) als project implementatie.

Wat bieden we jou?    

Werken bij HSO is uitdagend, we willen je daar graag een goede beloning voor teruggeven. Naast goede primaire voordelen bieden wij:  

  • Een competitief salaris, een jaarlijkse bonus op basis van bedrijfs-, team- en individuele prestaties;  
  • Mobiliteitsvergoeding waarbij je of een auto kunt leasen of het bedrag toe kunt voegen aan je salaris. Daar bovenop krijg 100% betaald van de ov-kosten; 
  • 25 vakantiedagen met de mogelijkheid om er 35 van te maken;  
  • Hybride werken, vanuit huis, op kantoor (Rotterdam, Veenendaal) of zelfs tijdens je Workation;  
  • EUR 65,- netto vitaliteitsbudget – we vinden het belangrijk dat we gezond blijven en een veilige werkplek hebben, zowel op kantoor als remote;  
  • Je kunt deelnemen aan het leasefietsplan;  
  • En vooral een leven lang leren. Op dag één start jouw onboardingprogramma, daarnaast krijg je een persoonlijk studiebudget dat je kunt inzetten voor jouw professionele ontwikkeling en ontvang je ook een GoodHabitz account, een online trainingstool voor je persoonlijke ontwikkeling.   

Waarom HSO   

HSO is de eerste full-service Microsoft Partner in Nederland. Samen met ruim 2500 getalenteerde medewerkers in Europa, Azië en Noord-Amerika verlenen we ondersteuning op lokaal en internationaal niveau aan industriële bedrijven, retailers, financiële en zakelijke dienstverleners en overheidsinstellingen.  
  

HSO is voortdurend op zoek naar nieuw talent. We blijven onze wereldwijde community uitbreiden en scheppen er plezier in om samen te werken met prestatiegerichte mensen met een ondernemersgeest. Professionals die voortdurend willen leren en innoveren.  

Vrijheid, flexibiliteit en fun  

Je werkt in een internationale omgeving met professionals met verschillende nationaliteiten. title: Solution Engineer  - Public Sector  - UK
descriptionHtml:
What we are all about

Do you ever have the urge to do things better than the last time? We do. And it’s this urge that drives us every day. Our environment of discovery and innovation means we’re able to create deep and valuable relationships with our customers to create real change for them and their industries. It’s what got us here – and it’s what will make our future. At Quantexa, you will find autonomy and support in equal measures, with the freedom to grow a career that matches your ambitions. We are proud of our global culture: 41% of our colleagues come from an ethnic or religious minority background, we speak over 20 languages, and represent 50+ nationalities, creating a powerful sense of belonging across all teams. We're heading in one direction: the future. We’d love you to join us!

The Opportunity

We are looking for an exceptional candidate to join our high-performing team of Solution Engineers in the UK, with a focus on the Public Sector. You will collaborate closely with regional peers across Alliances, Sales, Marketing, and Product to help win strategic sales opportunities.

We are seeking someone with strong technical expertise and business insight who can articulate complex technical concepts in a clear, compelling way. You will be comfortable in a hands-on role, delivering impactful presentations, product demonstrations, and deep dives across customer engagements. As a key technical spokesperson for Quantexa, you’ll build lasting trust with stakeholders by engaging them in relevant, value-driven conversations that address the unique challenges of central government.

Location

This role is based in London and will require travel to customer sites where appropriate. This is a hybrid role but with expectations to be on client site or in the London office at least two times per week.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Be a functional and technical expert in Quantexa’s platform and products, with a strong understanding of its capabilities and real-world applications.

  • Demonstrate a good understanding of UK central government practices and how the platform addresses operational challenges.

  • Articulate and present the value of our platform, demonstrating how Quantexa solves specific pain points and enables better decision-making.

  • Represent Quantexa at industry events, customer meetings, and webinars, showcasing our capabilities and thought leadership.

  • Manage the technical aspects of the sales cycle, working alongside Sales, Architects, and Product teams.

  • Contribute to winning proposals, including RFPs and RFIs.

  • Take ownership of the design and execution of PoCs and trials, ensuring alignment with customer objectives.

  • Collaborate on the design of tailored solutions, working with partners, customers, and internal teams to define the right approach.

  • Deliver engaging product demonstrations, both in-person and remotely, that connect with stakeholders from users to executives.

  • Facilitate discovery sessions with prospects, uncovering core business challenges and technical needs.

What You’ll Bring

  • Experience in a commercially focused, hands-on technical role such as Solution Engineering, Presales, or Technical Consulting, ideally from a Systems Integrator (SI) or a similar technology vendor.

  • Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills, with a track record of effective customer engagement.

  • A great communicator, able to captivate audiences with an innate ability to simplify complex concepts for diverse audiences.

  • Proven experience working with UK public sector clients, with a good understanding of the operational and technical challenges within central government departments.

  • Experience leading extensive proving engagements, such as PoCs or early implementation phases, including activities like technical workshops, prototypes, and bespoke demonstrations.

  • Confident in delivering engaging presentations and pitches that connect functionality to business value.

  • Experience building demos, templates, or sharing best practices that contribute to team enablement

Desired Skills

  • Strong expertise in data-driven, analytical solutions such as Entity Resolution, Graph Analytics, and MDM.

  • Domain knowledge in UK public sector areas such as tax and revenue, social security, or home affairs is highly desirable.

  • Technical expertise in data storage, processing, and containerization technologies such as Cloud or On-prem Distributed File Systems, Spark, Kubernetes, and Elasticsearch.

Our perks and quirks.

What makes you Q will help you to realize your full potential, flourish and enjoy what you do, while being recognized and rewarded with our broad range of benefits.

We offer:

  • Competitive salary & Company bonus

  • 25 days annual leave (with the option of buying up to 5 days, and rolling over up to 10), plus national holidays + your birthday off!

  • Pension scheme with a company contribution of 6% (when you contribute 3%)

  • Private Healthcare, including dental & optic cover

  • Life Insurance and Income Protection

  • Regularly bench-marked salary rates

  • Enhanced Maternity, Paternity, Adoption, or Shared Parental Leave

  • Well-being days

  • Volunteer Day off

  • Work from Home Equipment

  • Commuter, Tech and cycle to work schemes

  • Free Subscription to a meditation, relaxation and sleep app

  • Continuous Training and Development

  • Spend up to 2 months working outside of your country of employment over a rolling 12-month period with our ‘Work from Anywhere’ policy

  • Team Social Budget & Company-wide Socials

Our mission.

We have one mission. To help businesses grow. To make data easier. And to make the world a better place. We’re not a start-up. Not anymore. But we’ve not been around that long either. What we are is a collection of bright, passionate minds harnessing complexities and helping our clients and their communities. One culture, made of many. Heading in one direction – the future.

It’s all about you.

We want you to feel welcome, valued, and respected - because it’s your individuality and passion that make you Q. We see that, and we celebrate it. That’s why we’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment, continuously improving to ensure everyone belongs. Our recruitment process is designed to be inclusive and accessible. If you need any reasonable adjustments or accommodations, please let our Talent Acquisition Team know - we’re happy to assist.

No matter your race, beliefs, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, neurodiversity, or abilities—whoever you are—if you're a passionate, curious, and caring human eager to push the boundaries of what’s possible, we want to hear from you.
