title: Technical Instructional Designer (AI Programmes)
descriptionHtml:
Multiverse is the upskilling platform for AI and Tech adoption.

We have partnered with 1,500+ companies to deliver a new kind of learning that's transforming today’s workforce.

Our upskilling apprenticeships are designed for people of any age and career stage to build critical AI, data, and tech skills. Our learners have driven $2bn+ ROI for their employers, using the skills they’ve learned to improve productivity and measurable performance.

In April 2026, we announced $70 million in strategic funding, led by Schroders Capital, with participation from StepStone Group, Lightspeed Venture Partners and General Catalyst. At an increased valuation of $2.1bn, the round makes us Europe’s first EdTech double unicorn.

But we aren’t stopping there. With a strong operational footprint and 800+ employees, we have ambitious plans to continue scaling. We’re building a world where tech skills unlock people’s potential and output.

Join Multiverse and power our mission to equip the workforce to win in the AI era.

The opportunity

AI can draft a lesson in seconds. It can't tell you whether that lesson will actually land with a nervous career-switcher three weeks into an AI apprenticeship — or whether the concept it just explained is subtly, but fundamentally, flawed.

That's where you come in.

You'll be the human judgement layer sitting on top of our AI-assisted content pipeline — part subject-matter expert, part instructional designer. You'll decide what AI got right, fix what it didn't, and build the parts no AI can: the high-touch, high-stakes, deeply human moments in a learner's journey that make the difference between content that's technically correct and content that actually changes someone's career.

You'll have experience building content in generative and/or agentic AI — not just someone who's read about it, but someone who can explain it, question it, and know when the AI-generated explanation of tricky subjects is actually going to help a learner or quietly confuse them.

 

What you'll actually do

  • Design outcomes, not just content. Apply end-to-end backward design to build AI programmes and content where success is measured by what learners can do on the job — not just what they can pass a test on. You'll own the hardest part: turning a job-aligned outcome into content that actually gets learners there.

  • Chase real-world impact, relentlessly. When a piece of learning isn't landing — when an AI practitioner cohort isn't showing the outcomes it should — you won't wait to be told. You'll spot it, own it, and scope the revisions that bring it up to the standard it needs to hit.

  • Build what AI can't. Design the custom, high-touch programmes and creative assets — branching narratives, bespoke multimedia, high-stakes onboarding moments — that need real human empathy, creativity, and nuance. If AI could have built it, it's not your job; if only a person could, it is.

  • Put AI to work, deliberately. Use AI tools and prompt engineering to accelerate your own content development and uncover learning design approaches nobody's tried yet. This isn't about using AI because it's there — it's about knowing exactly where it earns its place.

  • Advise up, not just build. Work directly with Programme Designers and senior stakeholders on the quality and pedagogical effectiveness of the content you design. Your feedback doesn't stay in the room — it shapes how our rules, principles and frameworks evolve.

  • Prototype for the long game. Lead new learning formats and modalities that don't exist yet — and know how to balance shipping fast against building something sustainable enough to reuse.

     

What you'll bring

  • Real command of end-to-end ADDIE and backward design — you've built measurable, job-aligned outcomes and the assessments that prove learners hit them, not just theoretical frameworks on a CV.

  • A habit of treating "good enough" as a starting point, not a finish line — you notice when learning isn't driving real outcomes, and you take the initiative to fix it.

  • Genuine fluency with AI-powered tools and prompt engineering, used to accelerate content development and find genuinely new applications in learning design.

  • The ability to take a genuinely complex generative and/or agentic AI concept and design a learning experience around it that actually works — for a range of different learner personas

  • The confidence and track record to influence peers and senior stakeholders toward a specific, measurable curriculum improvement — not just raise a concern and move on.

  • Resilience when things don't go to plan — you can point to a time a project hit a real obstacle (a blocker, a shifting SME, a launch that missed the mark) and describe exactly what you did about it, and what you learned.

What gets you in the door

You'll need at least one of these:

  • Hands-on experience producing technical content for generative and/or agentic AI.

  • 2+ years designing instructional content in a commercial environment or for commercial clients.

  • Plus one of:

    • A Data or Computer Science degree (or close cousin of one)

    • Completion of a technical apprenticeship in Data or AI

    • 2+ years working as a practitioner in Data or AI

 

If you're a strong technical practitioner who's never formally studied instructional design, or a seasoned learning designer who's spent the last year deep in AI tools — either path can get you here. We're looking for the judgment, not a checklist.

 

What we'll actually explore together

We're upfront about what our process looks for, because we'd rather you come prepared to talk about the real thing than guess what we want to hear. Across the conversations, we'll dig into:

  • Advanced curriculum & applied design — how you turn an end-to-end backward-design process into measurable, job-aligned outcomes, and how you build creative assets that genuinely need a human touch.

  • Impact & excellence — what you do when a piece of learning isn't hitting its real-world mark, and how you weigh speed against building something built to last.

  • AI integration & innovation — where and how you've put AI tools and prompt engineering to work, and what that's actually unlocked.

  • Influence & stakeholder management — how you've moved a curriculum forward through a genuine disagreement or feedback conversation, not just delivered a good pitch.

  • Coachability & resilience — how you've handled a launch that didn't land, or a project blocker outside your control, and what you changed as a result.

Benefits

  • Time off - 27 days holiday, plus 5 additional days off: 1 life event day, 2 volunteer days, 2 company-wide wellbeing days (M-Powered Weekend) and 8 bank holidays per year

  • Health & Wellness- private medical Insurance with Bupa, a medical cashback scheme, life insurance, gym membership & wellness resources through Wellhub and access to Spill - all in one mental health support

  • Hybrid work offering - for most roles we collaborate in the office three days per week with the exception of Coaches and Instructors who collaborate in the office once a month

  • Work-from-anywhere scheme - you'll have the opportunity to work from anywhere, up to 10 days per year

  • Space to connect: Beyond the desk, we make time for weekly catch-ups, seasonal celebrations, and have a kitchen that’s always stocked!


Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

We’re an equal opportunities employer. And proud of it. Every applicant and employee is afforded the same opportunities regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. This will never change. Read our Equality, Diversity & Inclusion policy here.

Our Commitment to Safeguarding

Multiverse is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of our learners. We expect all employees to share this commitment and adhere to our Safeguarding Policy, our Prevent Policy and all other Multiverse company policies. Successful applicants will be required to undertake at least a Basic check via the Disclosure Barring Service (DBS).

For roles that will involve a Regulated Activity, successful applicants must also undergo an Enhanced DBS check, including a Children’s Barred List check and a Prohibition Order check. Roles involving Regulated Activity may interact with vulnerable groups, therefore are exempt from the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act 1974 meaning applicants are required to declare any convictions, cautions, reprimands, and final warnings.

Providing false information is an offence and could result in the application being rejected or summary dismissal if the applicant has been selected, and possible referral to the police and the DBS.

title: Technical Project Manager - Engineering Delivery
descriptionHtml:
Diabolocom is looking for a Technical Project Manager to coordinate engineering delivery across our organization and work closely with the Head of Software Engineering on roadmap execution.

You will work across Engineering, Product, Infrastructure and Project teams to keep delivery on track, manage dependencies, identify risks early, and help turn delivery challenges into clear actions and decisions.

We are looking for someone with a software engineering background who has moved into technical leadership and genuinely enjoys the operational side of engineering.

The role

Our engineering organization includes around 90 engineers across 12 teams, working on a complex global product and multiple parallel initiatives.

This role combines ownership of our engineering delivery processes with hands-on execution. You will be responsible not only for running these processes, but also for continuously improving how we plan, coordinate and track delivery across the organization.

Process ownership

You will own and continuously improve:

  • engineering delivery planning processes
  • delivery tracking and reporting
  • cross-team coordination and dependency management.

You will build on our existing practices and ClickUp workflows, identifying what can work better and evolving the processes as the organization and product develop.

Delivery execution

Day to day, you will:

  • track delivery across teams and releases
  • coordinate dependencies and clarify ownership across teams
  • identify risks, blockers and delivery gaps early
  • challenge unclear timelines, priorities and commitments
  • coordinate next steps when delivery is at risk
  • provide clear visibility on delivery status and progress.

You will work closely with Engineering, Product, Infrastructure and Project teams to facilitate alignment.

The objective is simple: make software delivery predictable, transparent and effective.

What success looks like

First few weeks: You start taking ownership of delivery operations and become effective in coordinating ongoing delivery.

Within ~6-8 weeks: You understand the roadmap, teams, dependencies and delivery processes well enough to manage them confidently and start identifying opportunities for improvement.

Within 3 months: You operate autonomously across day-to-day engineering delivery coordination, bringing in the Head of Software Engineering when decisions or trade-offs require escalation.

Your work will directly influence our delivery efficiency and predictability: how much we can take on and how reliably we deliver what we commit to.

Who we are looking for

We are looking for someone who started in software engineering and moved into technical leadership, for example, an Engineering Manager, Technical Lead, senior Team Lead, or Technical Program Manager.

Titles matter less than scope. You need enough technical depth to understand architecture and dependencies, ask the right questions, and navigate complex delivery problems across teams.

We expect

  • around 10 years of experience in software engineering environments
  • at least 3 years in engineering or technical leadership
  • previous hands-on experience as a software engineer
  • experience leading or coordinating multiple engineering teams
  • a track record of delivering complex software initiatives and improving execution
  • strong understanding of the software development lifecycle, distributed systems and cross-team dependencies
  • understanding of Product Management fundamentals
  • experience with Agile and structured project management frameworks such as PMBOK or similar
  • strong prioritization, decision-making and communication skills
  • professional fluency in English.

French and Russian are nice to have.

This role will suit you if…

You still enjoy technical complexity, but what really motivates you is making execution work.

You like finding out why something is stuck and fixing it.

You genuinely enjoy the operational side of engineering: creating structure, improving processes, coordinating teams and making sure things get delivered.

You don’t just want to follow an established process. You naturally look for ways to make it work better.

You are comfortable working across multiple teams, asking difficult questions when needed, and bringing structure to situations where priorities, dependencies or timelines are not immediately clear.

Why Diabolocom

Diabolocom is building one of Europe’s most advanced AI-native CCaaS platforms, powering business-critical customer interactions for 400+ enterprise and mid-market customers across 60+ countries.

We combine a mature global CCaaS platform with a rapidly growing AI Product Suite, backed by our internal AI Research Lab and proprietary AI innovation.

Our ambition goes beyond adding AI features to an existing product. We are building toward a platform capable of orchestrating AI agents, human agents, business workflows and communication channels, with CCaaS as the execution layer.

For Engineering, this means working on the technical and operational challenges of an established enterprise product, from real-time communications and distributed systems to complex integrations, while contributing to its next generation.

With teams across Europe, the US, Brazil and the UAE, and an engineering organization of around 90 people, this role offers the opportunity to work on engineering delivery behind a global product used for critical customer operations.

Why this role

This is a hands-on role combining delivery execution with process ownership.

You will work with the Head of Software Engineering, Team Leads, Product, Infrastructure and Project teams, with a broad view of engineering delivery across the organization.

You will inherit established delivery practices, own them, and continuously improve how we plan, coordinate and track execution.

Recruitment process

  1. Introductory call with Talent Acquisition
  2. Interview with the Head of Software Engineering
  3. Interview with the CTO
  4. Interview with the Head of Product

Logistics

📍 Paris, France
🏢 Hybrid model: minimum 3 days/week onsite
💻 Equipment: choose your preferred setup (Mac/Linux + monitors)
🍽 Lunch vouchers
🚇 Navigo: 50% of the monthly pass reimbursed

title: Technical Recruiter, EMEA
descriptionHtml:
The R&D team at Chainalysis is inspired by solving the hardest challenges and building products that establish trust in cryptocurrencies. We're a global organization that thrives on challenging work and doing it alongside exceptionally talented teammates. Our industry evolves rapidly, and our mission is to build a flexible, AI-driven platform that automates entity resolution, optimizes data labeling pipelines, and creates predictive models that identify illicit patterns before they escalate.

Our data and solutions have been used to solve some of the world's most high-profile criminal cases and grow consumer access to cryptocurrency safely. Now, by pairing the industry's most trusted blockchain data with agents that reason, investigate, and act, we help our customers scale their workflows as the cryptocurrency economy becomes increasingly mainstream.

Talent Acquisition at Chainalysis is a small, close-knit team that partners with leaders across the business to hire the people who will carry our mission forward. We share sourcing wins, market learnings, and process improvements openly, and we hold ourselves to a high bar for both results and candidate experience.

We are hiring a Technical Recruiter to own and drive hiring for Engineering & Product roles in our EMEA locations. This is a high-volume, outbound-heavy role: you'll spend a meaningful portion of your time building pipeline through direct sourcing, identifying and engaging top engineering talent across AI, Crypto, and Fintech. You'll manage a full requisition load, move fast, and close strong candidates in a competitive market, with Software Engineering roles among your key hires. You'll work closely with hiring managers across our R&D teams as a talent partner who understands the business and delivers results.

In this role, you'll:

  • Build pipeline through proactive outbound sourcing, mapping the AI, crypto, and fintech landscape to find where strong Software Engineers work today

  • Develop creative sourcing strategies that go beyond LinkedIn InMails, including referral generation, community engagement, and direct outreach campaigns

  • Own the full recruiting lifecycle for R&D roles, from intake and sourcing through offer negotiation and close, across a high-volume requisition load

  • Deliver a thoughtful, personalised, and transparent candidate experience at every step while moving candidates through the process efficiently

  • Partner with R&D leaders to calibrate expectations, share market insights on talent availability and compensation, and flag risks early so hiring plans stay on schedule

  • Use data on pipeline health, conversion rates, and channel effectiveness to guide decisions, and champion diversity and inclusion in every search

We're looking for candidates who have:

  • 3+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience with a strong track record of hiring technical talent, such as Software Engineers, Data Scientists, Researchers, and Product Managers

  • Demonstrated outbound sourcing ability: you build your own pipeline through direct outreach and do not rely on inbound applications to fill roles

  • High AI proficiency, using it for building pipeline proactively, workflows, processes, and documentation

  • Proven experience recruiting technical talent within the SaaS, AI, Blockchain, and Cybersecurity sectors, with a focus on candidates who have worked in fast-paced companies building technically complex products

  • Consistently utilised data to inform decision making and advise hiring managers through the hiring process

  • Strong organisational skills, sharp attention to detail, and consistent follow-through on every candidate and requisition

  • The ability to build credibility with hiring managers quickly, communicate market realities clearly, and guide decisions with data, in a collaborative, low-ego way

You might also have:

  • Experience recruiting for Blockchain companies with a focus on Engineering roles

  • A background at a high-growth scale up technology company

  • A track record of hiring for technical roles in Denmark, Israel, UK, and the USA

Tools we use:

  • Ashby ATS

  • Sourcing tools (LinkedIn Recruiter, Nova AI, GitHub)

  • Coderpad

  • Google suite, Slack, Chain AI

AI at Chainalysis
AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.

About Chainalysis

Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation.

You belong here. 

At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.

We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. If you need any accommodations to make our interview process more accessible to you due to a disability, don't hesitate to let us know. You can learn more here. We can’t wait to meet you.

title: UI/UX Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Join SE3 Labs as a UI/UX Software Engineer

Design and build intuitive, high-performance interfaces for autonomous systems, turning complex operational capabilities into software that people can use confidently in the real world.

About SE3

SE3 Labs builds spatial intelligence and autonomy software for unmanned systems. We combine 3D computer vision, state estimation and AI to help autonomous platforms perceive their surroundings, know where they are and operate when GPS and other sensors become unreliable. Defence is a core application of our work today.

We are growing to a team of 100+ people. Join at a stage where you can shape our future, help us build the team and grow your responsibilities as the company expands.

Our founding team’s research has received more than 90,000 citations. You will work closely with technical founders and engineers with deep experience in computer vision and autonomous systems, turning that research depth into systems that work in the field

About the Role

As a UI/UX Software Engineer at SE3 Labs, you’ll take ownership of how our software looks, feels and performs. Your core challenge is to build one coherent interface system that works across many contexts: different devices, screen sizes, plugins and product features, from large command displays to small field devices with limited computing power. You’ll combine UX/UI design with hands-on front-end development, working closely with our software team. From integrating 3D visualisations to building interfaces for military personnel in the field, you’ll help shape a product from the ground up and see the direct impact of your work.

What You’ll Work On

  • Coherent UI System & Front-End Architecture: Design and build a modular, well-structured front-end and a consistent design language that spans our whole product range. Make it easy to add new plugins and features, and to run on different systems and devices, without losing consistency or maintainability.

  • UX/UI Design & Implementation: Work with the team to understand user needs, design and wireframe interfaces, and turn them into working software. Own both the user experience and the code that brings it to life.

  • Multi-Device & Performance: Build interfaces that adapt across small screens, tablets and large displays, and stay responsive on resource-constrained hardware. Identify bottlenecks, optimise rendering and deliver a smooth experience without relying on high-end devices.

  • 3D Visualisation Integration: Integrate 3D visualisations into the user interface so that they work smoothly alongside other features, including on devices with limited computing resources.

  • Plugin & Feature Interfaces: Build reusable UI components for different plugins and product features, so that third parties and internal teams can extend the platform in a consistent way.

  • Usability for Operational Environments: Help design interfaces for military personnel working in demanding conditions. Consider intuitive workflows, clear information hierarchy and established conventions such as NATO symbology. Learn from real user feedback and improve continuously.

  • Collaboration & Product Evolution: Work closely with the software team to understand customer needs and translate them into design and engineering decisions. Help shape how the interface evolves as the product grows, and look for ways to simplify workflows and make new capabilities easier to understand.

Your Profile

  • You enjoy building a coherent system rather than a single screen: one design language and one component structure that works across many plugins, systems and devices.

  • You bring hands-on experience designing and implementing user interfaces for software products, with a focus on intuitive, usable experiences across different devices and screen sizes.

  • You have built structured, responsive and maintainable front-end applications, not just static designs or isolated prototypes, and you know how to organise code into reusable components and modular structures.

  • You can move between UX/UI design and software development, turning wireframes and requirements into working interfaces and making informed decisions about both usability and implementation.

  • You care about performance as well as appearance, and you work methodically to improve the experience across different hardware.

  • You work well with engineers and other stakeholders, explore different approaches and turn ideas into practical solutions.

  • You take initiative, enjoy open-ended problems and want to help build and shape a product rather than maintain an established interface.

  • You’re interested in software for real-world use, where clarity, reliability and ease of use matter as much as visual design.

  • You’re happy to work on-site with the team in Munich.

Especially Valued Bonus Skills

  • 3D Visualisation: Experience integrating interactive 3D visualisations into software interfaces, particularly using Unreal Engine or similar technologies.

  • Performance on Constrained Hardware: Experience optimising front-end applications for low-compute devices, limited resources or demanding real-time requirements.

  • Complex Operational Interfaces: Experience designing interfaces for complex systems where users need to interpret spatial information, symbols or multiple sources of information quickly.

  • Gaming or Real-Time Visualisation: Experience in 3D gaming, motorsport, simulation or other fields where responsive interfaces and real-time visual feedback are important.

  • Building from Scratch: Experience establishing a front-end architecture, reusable component system or coherent design language for a new product or platform.

Perks & Benefits

  • Real Ownership: Participate in SE3’s growth through our employee participation programme

  • Work Environment to Excel at: Find a high-quality and modern toolset, flat hierarchy and a skilled, driven team which will push the limits together with you

  • AI-boosted workplace: We empower every employee with best-in-class AI tools and agents, giving you unlimited access to the latest advancements and a true productivity edge

  • 31 Paid Days Off: 30 vacation days plus your birthday off

  • Well-being Access: Free membership to gyms, yoga, and wellness through EGYM Wellpass

  • Team Offsites: We go on 2 company retreats per year, our last ones were in Italy and Greece

  • Mentorship: Work closely with experienced engineers and get paired with a professional mentor to support your growth

Our Process

  1. Intro Call (30 minutes): An initial conversation to discuss your experience, motivation and interest in SE3 Labs, alongside an introduction to the role and our working environment.

  2. Hiring Manager Interview (45 minutes): Discuss your experience, approach to software development and UX/UI design, and how you would contribute to the team.

  3. Technical Deep Dive (90 minutes): Explore your technical capabilities in more detail, including front-end architecture, interface design and implementation, responsive development and problem-solving.

  4. Team Lunch or Dinner: Meet members of the team, get a feel for how we work together and learn more about life at SE3 Labs.

We're looking for a Visual Designer to own how Omnea shows up in the physical world and across marketing campaigns. You'll lead design for events, print and traditional media, and presentations, and support Marketing with graphic design for campaigns, content and paid ads.

📋 Description du poste

En tant que Product Owner Clienteling, vous interviendrez auprès d'une grande Maison de luxe internationale sur l'évolution d'une application reposant sur l'écosystème Salesforce.

Véritable interface entre les équipes métier et techniques, vous accompagnerez la division dans la conception et l'amélioration de ses outils de clienteling, dans un environnement agile et international.

🎯 Responsabilités & Tâches clés

Votre quotidien s'articulera autour de quatre grands piliers :

1. Recueil des besoins & Recommandations Produit

  • Recueillir, analyser et challenger les besoins des équipes métier Retail et Digital.

  • Identifier les axes d'amélioration des parcours clients et des outils de clienteling.

  • Proposer des solutions fonctionnelles adaptées aux enjeux métier et aux usages en boutique.

2. Conception fonctionnelle & Gestion du Backlog

  • Rédiger les spécifications fonctionnelles, User Stories et critères d'acceptation.

  • Formaliser les parcours utilisateurs, règles de gestion et besoins d'intégration entre les outils.

  • Alimenter, prioriser et affiner le backlog en collaboration avec l'Application Manager.

  • Contribuer à la conception des maquettes et prototypes.

3. Suivi des développements & Méthodologie Agile

  • Assurer l'interface fonctionnelle entre les équipes métier et les développeurs iOS et Salesforce.

  • Participer aux cérémonies Agile (Daily, Sprint Planning, Refinement, Sprint Review).

  • Suivre l'avancement des développements et accompagner les arbitrages fonctionnels.

4. Recette, Déploiement & Accompagnement du changement

  • Préparer et participer aux phases de recette fonctionnelle et aux tests utilisateurs (UAT).

  • Suivre les anomalies et valider la conformité des fonctionnalités livrées.

  • Accompagner les déploiements internationaux et l'adoption des nouvelles fonctionnalités.

  • Produire les supports utilisateurs et assurer la communication auprès des équipes métier.

👤 Profil recherché

Pour réussir sur ce poste, nous recherchons un profil doté d'une forte expertise fonctionnelle, d'une bonne connaissance du luxe et du clienteling, ainsi que d'une excellente capacité à interagir avec les équipes métier.

  • Formation & Expérience : Vous justifiez idéalement de 3 à 5 ans d'expérience en tant que Business Analyst, Proxy Product Owner ou Product Owner sur des projets digitaux.

  • Expertise Métier : Vous possédez une expérience dans le secteur du luxe et une bonne maîtrise des enjeux de clienteling, CRM, Retail et omnicanalité.

  • Compétences Fonctionnelles : Vous maîtrisez le recueil des besoins, la rédaction de spécifications fonctionnelles, les User Stories et la gestion de backlog. Une connaissance de Salesforce est appréciée.

  • Gestion de projet & Agilité : Vous évoluez avec aisance dans un environnement Agile/Scrum et maîtrisez Jira. Une expérience sur des applications mobiles ou des projets internationaux constitue un atout.

  • Soft Skills : Autonome, diplomate et force de proposition, vous êtes reconnu(e) pour votre capacité d'analyse, votre sens du service et votre aisance dans la communication avec des interlocuteurs métier exigeants.

  • Langues : Anglais courant indispensable, à l'oral comme à l'écrit, dans un environnement international.

title: VP of Marketing
descriptionHtml:
Get to know us

Ideals is a global B2B SaaS product company recognized as the most highly rated and customer-centric brand in the secure business collaboration market. Trusted by over 2,000,000 users from 300,000 companies globally, we help people run high-stakes processes and make important decisions with less stress, higher quality, and shorter hours.

Ideals Virtual Data Room (VDR): Secure document sharing and collaboration for due diligence, fundraising, corporate reporting, licensing, clinical trials, and other complex transactions.

Ideals Board: Board and leadership collaboration platform for faster, safer, and more compliant decision-making.

The role

Ideals is uniquely positioned to redefine the VDR industry. Now we aim to own the upmarket M&A segment and establish Ideals as the Tier 1 brand in that space - translating market leadership into stronger brand equity, pipeline, and revenue. We're looking for a VP of Marketing to make this happen.

You'll lead a high-performing global team and shape the marketing function end-to-end: positioning and category authority, a scalable demand engine, and the operating system behind it. This is a builder's role for a strategic, data-driven leader who wants their work to show up in commercial results, not just in brand tracking.

This is a fully remote role for candidates based in the UK, Ireland, Switzerland, or the Netherlands.

 

What you will do

  • Define how Ideals wins
    You'll own positioning, messaging, competitive intelligence, and GTM plans across every product, segment, and region – the strategic foundation everything else in marketing builds on.

  • Build category authority
    From industry events, reports, and benchmarks to media relations, executive visibility, and speaking programmes - you'll make Ideals the name the upmarket M&A segment thinks of first, and keep every external touchpoint aligned with our brand positioning.

  • Turn attention into pipeline
    You'll drive demand generation across paid and organic channels, ABM, content, and nurture, then guide the team capturing it through search, review platforms, intent data, and conversion optimisation. As the Key Accounts Sales team scales, you'll direct regional programmes into each market's sales plan and own the result end to end against pipeline and revenue targets.

  • Run marketing as a system
    You'll own the martech and analytics stack, attribution, KPI framework, and ROI reporting – plus the marketing budget, agencies, and strategic vendors – so every decision is data-driven, and every dollar is accountable.

  • Lead the people who make it happen
    You'll hire, develop, and lead a global team, and work shoulder to shoulder with Sales, Product, and Customer Success to drive cohesive business growth.

What you bring

  • 10+ years of B2B marketing experience, with a strong SaaS background

  • 4+ years in a senior marketing leadership role within a fast-growing company, with responsibility for the broader marketing function

  • Proven experience leading and scaling diverse high-performing marketing teams, including hiring, talent development, and performance management

  • Brand marketing portfolio with proven activation expertise across diverse channels and markets

  • Hands-on experience across content, design, and growth initiatives, with the ability to go deep when needed

  • Track record scaling digital and field marketing programs that measurably grew pipeline and revenue

  • Solid understanding of demand generation and ABM initiatives

  • Successful track record of implementing marketing initiatives based on analytical and data-driven decisions

  • Excellent communication and problem-solving skills with a can-do attitude

  • Fluency in English (C1+ level)

Nice to have

  • Experience in M&A, Investment Banking, or Financial Services, with a strong understanding of the dealmaking ecosystem

What we offer

We highly value our people, so we will empower you with all the resources and support to help you reach your full potential.

 

For your best work

  • Remote-first flexibility to shape your ideal workday

  • Home workplace budget

  • Co-working expense coverage

  • Individual IT budget for extra equipment

  • Top-tier tech and AI-powered tools

 

For your growth

  • Access to Ideals Academy with numerous courses

  • Investment in external learning and development activities

  • Guidance in Personal Development Plan creation

  • Professional literature and subscriptions coverage

  • Support of your passion as a speaker or writer

  • Internal talent mobility opportunities

 

For your well-being

  • Tailored Wellness Package for your physical and mental health

  • Funding for sports competitions

  • Paid health-related time-off

  • 25 business days of annual leave

  • Nest Pensions scheme contribution

 

Extra perks

  • Budget for meetups with your local team

  • Generous internal referral program

 

Our culture

Commitment, Excellence, Collaboration, Trust and Care are core values to the Ideals team. For us, these are the principles that every Idealer lives and breathes. We are on the lookout for like-minded individuals who share our values. By doing so, we create a team where talents feel at ease and work to the best of their abilities.

Discover more.

 

Ideals is an equal opportunity employer

Ideals is made up of people from a wide variety of backgrounds and lifestyles. We embrace diversity and invite applications from people from all walks of life. We don’t discriminate against employees or applicants based on gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, religion, age, national origin, or citizenship.

title: VP Product & Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Tout ce que nos clients voient et utilisent, c’est vous qui le concevez. Nous créons le poste de VP Product & Engineering pour faire de notre puissance GPU une gamme de services d’IA que les développeurs prennent en main en quelques minutes : inférence managée, déploiement de modèles, notebooks, API.

Qui sommes nous ?

Arkane Cloud est un Cloud Service Provider lyonnais, conçu pour l’IA et hébergé en Europe, avec des datacenters à Paris et à Lyon.

Notre propre infrastructure GPU permet à des startups, des chercheurs et des entreprises de déployer leurs modèles en quelques minutes, dans le respect du RGPD et jusqu’à 70 % moins cher qu’avec un hyperscaler.

Notre ambition : bâtir un acteur européen de référence de l’infrastructure IA.

Pourquoi ce poste ?

Arkane Cloud passe de 10 à 50 personnes d’ici fin 2027, et sa direction s’organise autour de deux rôles complémentaires, tous deux rattachés au CEO. Le VP Infrastructure fait tourner nos datacenters, nos serveurs GPU, le réseau et le stockage. Le VP Product & Engineering construit tout ce que nos clients voient et utilisent.

Vous dirigez deux pôles :


• Product : l’expérience de nos clients, de la console à l’onboarding, avec la documentation et l’analytics produit.
• Engineering : la plateforme elle-même : API publique, SDK et CLI, comptes et droits, facturation à l’usage, services d’IA managés.

Vos missions

• Bâtir nos services IA

• Porter la vision et la roadmap de la plateforme

• Structurer et faire grandir les pôles Product et Engineering.

• Solidifier les fondations

• Co-construire avec le VP Infrastructure les API de provisioning, les nouvelles offres GPU et leur pricing (avec le CSO), la gestion des incidents et la communication client.

Vos 6 premiers mois

• 1er mois : rencontre des clients et des équipes, état des lieux de la console, de l’API, des services d’inférence et de la facturation.

• 3 mois : roadmap produit et IA à 12 mois validée avec le CEO, organisation des pôles Product et Engineering posée, interfaces avec l’Infrastructure formalisées.

• 6 mois : un premier service IA managé lancé ou refondu, indicateurs produit suivis chaque mois, recrutements clés réalisés.

Votre expérience

• 10 ans ou plus en engineering avec une dimension produit, dont au moins 3 ans à la tête de pôles produit et techniques.

• Au moins une solution IA construite et mise en production à l’échelle : plateforme d’inférence, MLOps, API de modèles ou produit cloud pour développeurs.

Vos expertises

Indispensables :

• IA et inférence : moteurs de serving (vLLM, SGLang ou équivalent), déploiement et optimisation de modèles en production.

• Kubernetes : vous savez concevoir des services qui y tournent et dialoguer d’égal à égal avec l’équipe Infrastructure.

• Facturation à l’usage et IAM : mesure de la consommation, billing, authentification, gestion des droits.

• Management de pôles en croissance, anglais professionnel courant.

Un vrai plus :

  • Expérience chez un cloud provider, un neocloud GPU ou une plateforme MLOps ;

  • Connaissance des marketplaces de modèles.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre

• Du poids dans les décisions, vous serez rattaché au CEO, vous définissez la stratégie produit avec le VP Infrastructure.
• Une équipe à bâtir. Deux pôles, Product et Engineering, à structurer pendant le passage de 10 à 50 personnes.
• Un produit qui porte votre signature : console, API, facturation, services d’IA managés : tout ce que nos clients utilisent, c’est vous qui le concevez.
• Un cloud IA européen à construire. Un cloud GPU souverain, pour des clients qui veulent garder la maîtrise de leurs modèles et de leurs données.

Package et avantages

• 90 – 110 k€ brut annuel, BSPCE

• Deux jours de présentiel (mercredi/jeudi) pour les profils de la région lyonnaise ou deux jours toutes les deux semaines pour les profils en dehors de la région lyonnaise.

• Mutuelle à 100 %, tickets restaurant, RTT (Convention Syntec)

Arkane Cloud s’engage pour la diversité : nous étudions toutes les candidatures, sans distinction de genre, d’âge, d’origine ou de handicap.

title: Welding Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.


We are developing the technologies and capabilities needed to make space exploration more accessible. We are looking for a Welding Specialist Engineer to support the industrialization and production readiness of our next-generation thruster hardware, including EBW activities, orbital welding and laser-welded components for a high-thrust engine.

This is an intermediate-level engineering role, working closely with and under the technical guidance of our Senior Welding Specialist Engineer. You will support electron beam welding (EBW) for our new thruster, laser-welding activities for a high-thrust engine and participate on the manufacturing of the orbital welding for the our Nyx capsule propulsion.

You will bring practical knowledge and you will work with design, manufacturing, quality and production teams to turn robust welding requirements into repeatable, well-documented manufacturing processes.


What you will do

  • Support the development, implementation and continuous improvement of EBW processes for the new thruster and laser-welding processes for our high-thrust engine.

  • Support orbital welding activities (being a qualified welder and support non conformance management).

  • Draft, review and maintain Welding Procedure Specifications (WPS) and related welding documentation; support procedure qualification and qualification records in accordance with applicable NASA requirements and program flow-downs.

  • Support the assessment of weldability, joint design and manufacturing risks, working with design and manufacturing engineering colleagues.

  • Prepare and maintain clear welding documentation, including process records, qualification evidence and traceability information.

  • Promote safe, disciplined and quality-focused manufacturing practices.


What you bring

  • A degree or equivalent practical experience in welding engineering, materials or manufacturing engineering, metallurgy, mechanical engineering, or a related discipline.

  • Professional experience in welding or manufacturing engineering, with the ability to contribute independently to defined tasks while seeking guidance on complex or novel issues.

  • Practical knowledge of TIG and plasma welding, with experience or familiarity in laser welding or other precision joining processes.

  • A strong interest in electron beam welding and the ability to support process development, qualification and production-readiness activities.

  • Working knowledge of WPS preparation and control, welding procedure qualification, inspection and traceability; familiarity with NASA qualification requirements applicable to the program is an advantage.

  • The ability to interpret technical drawings and specifications and to produce accurate, structured engineering documentation.

  • A methodical, safety-conscious approach and strong collaboration skills across engineering, quality and production teams.

  • Professional working proficiency in English.


Especially valuable

  • Direct experience with EBW, including process development, qualification or production support.

  • Experience with laser-welding process development, qualification or production support, especially for propulsion hardware; experience with automated TIG or other precision joining processes is also valuable.

  • Experience supporting propulsion hardware, pressure-containing components or other demanding aerospace manufacturing applications.

  • Familiarity with quality-management systems and configuration-controlled manufacturing documentation.

Why you should join us!

title: Working Student - Customer Care (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
At Instagrid, you are part of the clean-tech revolution by bringing pure energy into your region, helping professional workers transitioning away from combustion generators and making it possible for them to experience a safe, efficient, clean and silent energy solution.

Your Mission

Instagrid builds portable battery power systems for trades and pros. Our Pilot Fleet is how customers try them out before they buy. As a Working Student in Customer Care, you keep that fleet running. You handle demo requests, shipments, returns, check-ups, service and upgrades, and you support the team with everyday tickets and Salesforce-based Order-to-Cash processes.

You’ve done a great job when demo units are ready whenever Sales needs them, turnaround times stay short, the pool data in Salesforce and NetSuite is accurate, and our monthly fleet analytics give Customer Care and Sales leads a clear view of utilization and demo-to-order conversion.

Your Impact

  • Pilot requests: Receive, review and prioritize incoming demo requests, confirm unit availability and maintain an accurate Pilot Fleet inventory

  • Fulfillment: Prepare, pack and dispatch pilot units with the appropriate accessories, issue shipping and return documentation and track each unit from dispatch through to return

  • Communication: Maintain close contact with the Sales team and customers to ensure seamless delivery and pickup

  • Inspection and service: Coordinate inspections and functional tests of returned units with the Service team and schedule repairs and upgrades to bring units back into circulation quickly

  • Analytics: Maintain Pilot Fleet reporting (utilization, turnaround time, demo-to-order conversion, fleet condition) and prepare monthly insights for Customer Care and Sales leads

  • Process improvement: Identify friction points in the demo process, propose solutions and help document standard procedures in Confluence

  • Customer Care support: Support the team with day-to-day support tickets and Salesforce-based Order-to-Cash processing

  • Enablement: Support all stakeholders involved through structured documentation and process support


  • Currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s program in Business Administration, Industrial Engineering, Logistics, Supply Chain Management or a comparable field

  • Availability of 16–20 hours per week during the semester, with increased capacity during semester breaks, on-site in Ludwigsburg

  • A hands-on, structured approach to work and a strong sense of ownership for maintaining a physical fleet and the data that supports it

  • Proficiency in working with AI tools (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT)

  • Dependable and self-motivated, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent requests effectively

  • Fluent in English, with strong written and verbal communication skills

  • Nice to have: German language skills and initial exposure to enterprise software (Jira, Salesforce, NetSuite)

Your Benefits

  • Real ownership: from day one, the live Pilot Fleet is yours to run, with real responsibility instead of busywork

  • Flexibility for your studies: working hours coordinated around your lectures and exams

  • Broad experience: learn how a hardware company works end to end, from customer care and sales to service and operations

  • Hands-on tool skills: work with Salesforce, NetSuite, Jira and Confluence in a real business setting

  • Direct access to a lean, senior team: honest feedback, and room to push back and make your ideas count

  • Time to recharge: generous holiday entitlement plus additional special leave days, on a pro-rata basis

This is Instagrid

Pure instant power. Anywhere. We have created the world’s most advanced portable power supplies, bringing freedom to the way our customers work. With you we want to shape a world where advanced technology meets environmental responsibility and create lasting impact. Driven by our curiosity and the desire to leave tomorrow's world cleaner than we found it yesterday. Join us in transitioning away from combustion generators to a cleaner alternative for fast, measurable, and real outcomes. What we’ve achieved so far is just the beginning.
